Vehechan megalleach searo beezrat hannashim belishkat hannezirim shehayta sham bekeren mizrachit deromit veshem mevashshelin et shelamehen umashlichin searan laesh. veim gilleach bammedina yatza. uven sheggilleach bammedina uven sheggilleach bammikdash tachat haddud hu mashlich searo. veeno megalleach ad sheyyihye petach haazara patuach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 18)</small> "petach ohel moed". lo sheyyegallach keneged happetach shezze bizyon mikdash hu: 
Veachar kach notel hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela min haayil vechallat matztza achat min hassal verakik echad venotnan al kappe hannazir o hannezira umenifan veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulehittamme lemetim: 
Nazir memorat eno tzarich lehaavir taar. veaf al pi sheen lo sear o sheen lo kappayim hare ze makriv karbenotav veyishte veyittamme. veim hevi karbenotav velo gilleach rosho en hattiglachat meakkevet ella shote umittamme laerev. shemmishsheyyizzarek alav echad min haddamim huttar af al pi shello natan al kappav velo henif shekkol devarim ellu lemitzva velo leakkev: 
Af al pi sheen hattiglachat meakkev alav mitzva legalleach afillu leachar zeman merubbe. venazir sheggilleach belo taar o sheggilleach veshiyyer shete searot lo asa kelum velo kiyyem mitzvat gilluach. ben nazir tahor ben nazir tame: 
Gilleach vehinniach shete searot vetzimmeach rosho kullo vechazar vegillecho im otan shete hassearot o sheggilleach achat venashra achat hare ze kiyyem mitzvat gilluach. nashra achat vegilleach achat en kan mitzvat gilluach: 
Gilleach al hashshelamim venimtza pasul tiglachto pesula uzevachav lo alu lo. gilleach al hachattat venimtzet shello nishchata leshem chattat veachar kach hevi hashshelamim vehaola vehikrivan kemitzvatan tiglachto pesula uzevachav lo alu lo: 
Gilleach al haola veal hashshelamim venishchatu shello lishman veachar kach hevi karbanot acherot lehakerivan lishman tiglachto pesula uzevachav lo alu lo: 
Gilleach al shelashtan venimtza echad mehem kasher tiglachto keshera veyavi shear hazzevachim veyikkarvu kehilchatan: 
Kol makom sheamarnu tiglachto pesula hare hu kemi shennitgalleach betoch yeme neziruto shehu soter sheloshim yom kemo shebbearnu. venimtza mone sheloshim yom achar hattiglachat happesula veyavi karbenotav: 
Shalme nazir sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan kesherim veen olim labbealim leshem chova. veneechalin leyom echad veen teunin lechem velo mattanot velo zeroa: 
Shalosh behemot ellu vehallechem habba immahem hakkol min hachullin kishar nidre hekdesh kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Haomer hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach mimmeot maaser sheni hare ze nazir veeno mevi karbenotav min hammaaser ella min hachullin: 
Haish shennadar benazir yesh lo lehavi karbenot aviv leatzmo umegalleach alehem. veen haishsha megallachat al karbenot aviha vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala hu. ketzad. mi shehaya aviv nazir vehifrish maot liknot bahen karbenotav umet vehinniach hammaot setumin veamar achare mot aviv hareni nazir al menat sheavi karbenotay mimmaot shehifrish bahen avi lekarbenotav hare ze mevi mehen karbenotav. vechen im haya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot setumin umet haav veamar habben achar mot aviv hareni megalleach al meot avi hare ze mevi karbenotav mehen. aval im lo amar yippelu hammaot lindava. met haav vehinniach banim rabbim cholkim hammaot hassetumim mippene shehi yerushsha lahen veyesh lechol echad mehen legalleach al chelko vehabbechor notel bahen pi shenayim: 
Ben shehaya haav nezir olam vehabben nazir zeman katzuv ben shehaya haav nazir zeman katzuv vehabben nezir olam hare ze megalleach umevi karbenotav mimmeot nezirut aviv: 
Hifrish haav maot lehavi bahen karbenot tuma umet en habben mevi bahen karbenot tohora. vechen im hifrishan haav lekarban tohora en habben megalleach alehen tiglachat tuma. sheddevarim ellu hen safek veim hevi zevachav lo alu lo: 
Haomer hare alay legalleach nazir chayyav lehavi karbenot tiglachat tohora umakrivan al yad eze nazir sheyyirtze. amar hare alay chatzi karbenot nazir. o im amar hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir. hare ze mevi chatzi hakkarbanot leeze nazir sheyyirtze. veoto nazir mashlim karbenotav mishshello. aval im amar hare alay karbenot chatzi nazir hare ze mevi karbenot nazir shalem sheen lanu chatzi nezirut: 
Haomer hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani hare chavero nazir. veeno chayyav legalleach nazir acher. shehare lo hitpis atzmo ella binzirut. veim amar vaani vealay legalleach nazir hare ze chayyav. veim hayu pikchin mevi kol echad mehen karbanot al yede chavero veim lo asu chen chayyavim legalleach nezirut acherim: 
Haomer hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vealay legalleach chatzi nazir. ze mevi chatzi karbenotav shel ze veze mevi chatzi karbenotav shel ze vechol echad mehen mashlim karbenotav im hayu pikchin. veim lav ze mevi chatzi karbanot meeze nazir sheyyirtze veze mevi chatzi karbanot meeze nazir sheyyirtze:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 9: Hammafrish maot sheyyakriv mehen karbenot nezirim vehikriv mehen vehotiru yaviu bemotaran karbenot nezirim acherim. shemmotar nezirim linzirim. hifrish maot setumin linziruto vehotiru yippelu hammotarot lindava:

Hammafrish maot meforashin linziruto vehotiru. motar meot haola yavou ola. umotar hachattat yolichem leyam hammelach. umotar deme hashshelamim yavou shelamim. veen teunin lechem veneechalin leyom echad:

Hammafrish maot linziruto umet im hayu setumin yippelu lindava. hayu meforashin. deme ola [yavou ola]. deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach. deme shelamim yavou shelamim veneechalin leyom echad veen teunin lechem:

Ketzad hem hammaot hassetumin. kegon shehifrish maot lehavi mehen karbenotav velo amar kelum. aval im amar ellu lechovati hare ellu kimforashin. veen tzarich lomar im amar ellu leolati ulechattati velishlamay shehen kimforashin:
Hammafrish behema baalat mum hare hi kemaot setumin. vechen hammafrish lashon shel kesef veshel zahav o keli af al pi sheamar ze lechattati uleolati velishlamay hare hu kemaot setumin:
Haomer ellu lechattati vehashshear linziruti umet. o shehayta ishsha vehefer lah balah. deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach vehashshear yavou bechetzyan ola uvechetzyan shelamim:
Amar ellu leolati vehashshear linziruti deme ola yavou ola vehashshear yippelu lindava:

Mi sheddimma shehu chayyav binzirut vehifrish karbenotav veachar kach shaal lechacham vehorahu sheen ze neder veeno chayyav binzirut ma yaase bakkarbanot shehifrish. yetzu veyiru baeder. shezze hekdesh taut sheeno hekdesh kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Haishsha shennadra benazir vehifrisha karbenoteha veachar kach hefer lah balah im shello hayta habbehema tetze vetire baeder sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello. veim hayu hakkarbanot mishshellah veen levalah bahen kelum. kegon shennatnu lah bemattana al menat shello yihye labbaal bahen reshut ella ma shettirtze taase bahen. hachattat tamut. vehaola tikkarev ola. vehashshelamim yikkarvu shelamim. veneechalin leyom echad veenan teunin lechem:

Hifrisha maot setumin lekarbenoteha yippelu lindava. hayu meforashin deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach. udeme ola yavou ola. udeme shelamim yavou shelamim veneechalin leyom echad veenan teunin lechem:
Haishsha shennadra benazir venitmet betoch yeme nezirut veachar kach shama balah vehefer lah hare zo mevia karban tuma:

Haish shehiddir et beno benazir vehifrish alav karbenotav velo ratza habben binzirut zo. umacha hu o kerovav o sheggilleach hu o sheggillechuhu kerovav. hachattat tamut. vehaola tikkarev ola vehashshelamim yikkarvu shelamim veneechalin leyom echad veenan teunin lechem. hifrish lo maot setumim hare ellu yippelu lindava. hayu maot meforashin. deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach. deme ola yavou ola. deme shelamim yavou shelamim veenan teunin lechem veneechalin leyom echad:
Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vehifrish karban vehippila ishto vechazra veyalda. hare hakkarbanot safek vaasurin begizza uvaavoda:

Shene nezirim shennitma echad mehem veen yadua mi hu ketzad meviin karbenotehen. meviin karban tuma vekarban tohora bimlot yeme nezirutam. veomer echad mehem im ani hu hattame karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha. veim ani hu hattahor karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha. vesofrim yeme nezirut acheret gemura meachar karbanot ellu. vechozrin umeviin karban tohora. veomer echad mehen im ani hu shehayiti tame karban tuma shelli vekarban tohora shellecha veze karban tohorati. im ani hu hattahor karban tohora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha veze karban tohoratcha. nimtzeu shello hifsidu bekarbenotehen kelum:

Met echad mehen hare ze mevi chattat haof veolat behema. veyomar im tame hayiti hachattat mechovati vehaola nedava. veim tahor hayiti haola mechovati vechattat haof safek. vesofer yeme nezirut acheret umevi karban tohora. veomer im tame hayiti haola harishona nedava vezo chova veim tahor hayiti haola harishona chova vezo nedava veze shear karbani. veen echad mishshenehem megalleach tiglachat tuma ella im ken hayu ketannim o nashim sheen ellu makkifin peat rosham missafek:

Vechetzad yivvaled lahem safek ze betuma. kegon shehayu shene hannezirin omdin birshut hayyachid shessefek tuma sham tame vehaya echad mibbachutz roe otan veamar raiti echad mikkem shennitma veeni yodea mi hu. aval im haya ed ze immahen bechatzer hare shenehen tehorin. kevan shehem shelosha hare hen rabbim verabbim birshut hayyachid sefekan tahor kisfek tuma birshut harabbim shehu tahor kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheshshatku hannezirim shenehem o nistappek lahen haddavar. aval im amar echad mehen ani lo nitmeti afillu shene edim meidim alav shennitma eno mevi karban al pihem. shezze sheamar lo nitmeti keomer eni mevi betuma shekkevar nishalti al neziruti venimtza sheeno machchish et haedim veadam neeman al yede atzmo. aval im shatak o nistappek lo hare ze mevi karban afillu al pi ed echad kemo shebbearnu. vechen ed sheamar leechad befanay nadarta binzirut im hichchisho eno chayyav kelum. veim lo hichchisho noheg nezirut al piv. afillu amar lishnayim raiti echad mikkem shennazar veeni yodea mi hu hoil veen machchishin oto nohagin nezirut al piv. nahag nezirut al pi ed echad veshata yayin o nitma vehitru bo [shenayim] loke af al pi sheikkar hannezirut beed echad:
Met shehaya mushkav lerochav hadderech af al pi sheen sham makom laavor ella alav o nogea betziddo veaf al pi shehi tuma yedua veavar sham nazir hare ze tahor hoil vesafek birshut harabbim tahor:

Bamme devarim amurim bimhallech beraglav. aval im haya rochev o taun massa hare ze tame. shehammehallech beraglav efshar shello yigga o shello yaahil o shello yasit aval taun o rochev i efshar shello yigga veshello yaahil o shello yasit shehare hammet lerochav hadderech:
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 10: En adam megalleach tiglachat achat veola lo lenizro uletzarato. vetiglachat hatztzaraat bizman shehu sefek metzora eno doche et hannezirut. lefichach mi shennazar shana achat vehaya bechol hashshana hazzot sefek metzora usefek teme met o shehaya bah sefek metzora uvesof hashshana nitma besafek hare ze mone shiva yamim umazze bashshelishi ushevii veeno megalleach bashshevii veeno yachol lishtot beyayin ulehittamme lemet ella leachar arba shanim. veochel bekadashim leachar shete shanim mippene shehu tzarich legalleach arba tiglachiyyot. tiglachat tohora vetiglachat tuma missafek ushete tiglachiyyot shemmegalleach hametzora. shehare hu sefek metzora:

Tiglachat rishona megalleach otah achar shana rishona umegalleach bah rosho uzekano vegabbot enav. umittaher beetz erez veezov vetzipporim kishar metzoraim. im eno teme met velo metzora hare hi tiglachat tohora shel neziruto. veim hu metzora vadday beshana rishona hare hi tiglachat rishona shel metzora. veshohe shana acheret keminyan yeme hannezirut. veachar kach megalleach tiglachat sheniyya shel metzora. sheeno yachol legalleach achar shiva kishar metzorain shemma eno metzora ella teme met vadday haya veshana sheniyya zo hare hu bah nazir sheasur legalleach. umeachar sheggilleach shete tiglachiyyot ellu shalma tohorat hatztzaraat umuttar leechol bekadashim veshohe shana shelishit veachar kach megalleach tiglachat shelishit shemma metzora vadday haya beshana rishona velo haya teme met veshana rishona lo alta lo mippene shehi yeme chilluto veshana sheniyya lo alta lo mippene shehi yeme sefiro shel metzora shebben tiglachat rishona usheniyya. lefichach tzarich lishhot shana shelishit binziruto umegalleach tiglachat shelishit linziruto vehi tiglachat tohora. o shemma teme met vadday haya umetzora vadday veen tiglachat achat ola linziruto uletzarato venimtzet tiglachat rishona usheniyya tiglachat tzaraat vetiglachat shelishit tiglachat tuma veen achat mishshalosh shanim ola shehare hashshelishit tiglachat tuma. lefichach tzarich lishhot shana reviit binzirut umegalleach tiglachat reviit. usearo bechol tiglachat safek asur bahanaya missafek. shessear nazir shennitztarea muttar bahanaya:

Vechen im nadar eser shanim nezirut vehaya bahen sefek metzora venolad lo sefek tuma besofan hare ze eno shote beyayin ad arbaim shana umegalleach arba tiglachot achat besof kol eser shaniyim. tiglachat rishona lisfek yeme tzarato. sheniyya lisfek yeme sefiro shel metzora. shelishit lisfek tumato. reviit tiglachat tohora:

Vechetzad mevi ze karbenotav. im haya ashir kotev nechasav laacherim shemmetzora ashir shehevi karban ani lo yatza. veachar kach mevi chattat haof veolat behema betiglachat rishona usheniyya ushelishit. vechol chattat of mehen lo teachel mippene shehi safek. umevi betiglachat reviit karban nazir tahor shehu shalosh behemot kemo shebbearnu:

Shalosh chatteot haof shemmevi bishlosh hattiglachot. chattat rishona lisfek tumato. sheniyya lisfek tzarato sheen hametzora mevi karbano ella leachar tiglachat sheniyya. vechen chattat shelishit lisfek tumato sheen tiglachat achat ola lenizro uletzarato veshemma metzora vadday uteme met vadday haya shehattiglachat harishona vehashsheniyya letzarato kemo shebbearnu. vetiglachat shelishit tiglachat tuma ulefichach tzarich lehavi karban tuma bashshelishit:
Shalosh olot behema shemmevi immahen al harishona hu matne veomer im tahor ani zo mechovati veim tame ani hare hi nedava. vechen hu omer bashsheniyya uvashshelishit:

Umevi karban tohora betiglachat reviit. veomer umatne im tame hayiti ola rishona nedava vezo chova. veim muchlat hayiti rishona chovat metzora vezo chovat nezirut ushetayim haemtzaiyyot nedava. veim tahor mittumat met hayiti umetzora ola harishona chova vechen hashsheniyya achat lechovat metzora veachat lechovat nezirut ushelishit ureviit nedava vehashshear karban tohorati. veim tame hayiti umetzora ola rishona chovat tzaraat usheniyya ushelishit nedava veze karban tiglachat tohora:

Aval haasham vehaola enan meakkevin lo betiglachat tuma velo betzaraat. nimtzeta omer im hu metzora vadday velo nitma bemet hare tahar betzipporin vechattat haof hi chattato velo teachel mippene shehu safek veolat behema sheimmah mikkarban tiglachat tohora kede sheyyegalleach al habbehema. veim teme met hu hare olat behema nedava. veim eno metzora uteme met hu chattat haof karban nazir shennitma veolat behema nedava vahare hevi karban tohora baacharona. veim eno teme met velo metzora olat behema shehevi battiglachat harishona hi mechovat tiglachat vechattat haof baa al safek vahare lo neechelet:

Bamme devarim amurim shehu megalleach arba tiglachot keshehaya katan o ishsha. aval haish eno megalleach missafek lo tiglachat tuma velo tiglachat tzaraat. shemma tahor hu venimtza makkif peat rosho shello bimkom mitzva. lefichach eno megalleach ella tiglachat tohora bilvad. sheen arba tiglachot ellu leakkev ella lemitzva:

Nazir shennitztarea vadday venitma besafek ketzad hu ose. achar sheyyithar mitztzarato mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii umegalleach tiglachat tuma umatchil limnot neziruto kullah shehare naflu hayyamim harishonim bisfek tuma shennitma umevi karban tohora veshote beyayin. umeachar sheyyavi karban tzaraat ochel bekadashim:

Nitma vadday vehaya metzora besafek vetahar missefek tzarato mone yeme neziruto shelema veachar kach megalleach tiglachat hannega. sheen tiglachat sefek nigo docha nezirut. veachar kach mone shivat yamim shebben tiglachat metzora harishona letiglachat sheniyya umegalleach umevi karbenotav veochel bekadashim. umazze bishlishi ushevii. veachar kach mone shiva acherim letumat met umegalleach tiglachat tuma veachar kach mone neziruto kullah:

Vechen im haya tame umetzora bevadday. leachar sheyyithar mitztzarato megalleach tiglachat tzaraat harishona umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii umegalleach rosho uzekano bashshevii vehi tiglachat sheniyya shel tzaraat umevi karbenotav bashshemini veochel bekadashim vesofer shiva umegalleach tiglachat tuma veachar kach sofer yeme nezirut shelema umevi karban tohora veshote beyayin:
Lamma sofer shiva. sheen shivat yeme hattuma olin beshivat yeme sefira shebben tiglachat vetiglachat shel metzora:

Haomer hareni nazir im eese kach vechach o im lo eese vechayyotze baze hare ze rasha unezirut kazo minnezirut reshaim hu. aval hannoder laAdonai derech kedushsha hare ze nae umeshubbach veal ze neemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 7)</small> "nezer elohav al rosho" <small>(Bamidbar 6 8)</small> "kadsh hu laAdonai". ushekalo hakkatuv kenavi (shenneemar) <small>(Amos 2 11)</small> "vaakim mibbenechem linviim umibbachurechem linzirim": seliku lehu hilchot nezirut besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Appraisals and Devoted Pr:
Haarachim hem neder mikkelal nidre hekdesh. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 2)</small> "ish ki yafli neder beerkecha nefashot laAdonai". lefichach chayyavin alehen mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" v<small>(Devarim 23 22)</small> "lo teacher leshallemo" umishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase": 
Mitzvat ase ladun bedine arachin kaasher meforash battora. veechad haomer erki alay. o haomer erech ze alay. o erech peloni alay. noten haerech lefi shene hanneerach vehu haddavar hakkatzuv shebbattora lo pachot velo yeter: 
Vechamma hu haerech. im haya hanneerach ben sheloshim yom o pachot en lo erech vehaomer alav erech ze alay hare ze keomer erech keli ze alay veeno chayyav kelum. haya mibben echad usheloshim yom ad ben chamesh shanim gemurot erech hazzachar chamishsha shekalim vehannekeva shelosha shekalim. mishshennichnas bishnat shesh yom echad ad sheyyashlim shenat esrim erech hazzachar esrim shekalim vehannekeva asara shekalim. mishsheyyikkanes bishnat achat veesrim yom ad sheyyashlim shenat shishshim erech hazzachar chamishshim shekalim vehannekeva sheloshim shekalim. umishsheyyikkanes bishnat achat veshishshim yom ad yom moto afillu chaya kamma shanim erech hazzachar chamishsha asar shekalim vehannekeva asara shekalim: 
Kol hashshanim haellu meet leet miyyom halleda. vechol hashshekalim beshekel hakkodesh vehu mishkal shelosh meot veesrim seora mikkesef tahor. uchevar hosifu alav veasu oto sela kemo shebbearnu behilchot shekalim: 
Tumtum veanderoginus en lahem erech shello katzva tora erech ella lezachar vadday o linkeva vaddait. lefichach tumtum veanderoginus sheamar erki alay o sheheericho acher eno chayyav kelum: 
Haakkum neerach aval eno maarich. ketzad. akkum sheamar erki alay o erech yisrael ze alay lo amar kelum. veyisrael sheamar erech akkum ze alay o erech peloni haakkum alay noten lefi shene haakkum hanneerach. vechen hammaarich et hacheresh veet hashshote chayyav venoten lefi shanav: 
Haeved neerach veorech kishar yisrael. veim yippade vehaya lo yitten erech shennadar: 
Echad hammaarich et hayyafe habbari veechad hammaarich et hakkaur hachole. afillu haya hanneerach mukke shechin o suma o giddem veyesh bo kol mum noten lefi shanav kemo shekkatuv battora: 
Haddamim enan kaarachin. ketzad. haomer damay alay o deme ze alay o deme peloni alay afillu haya oto peloni katan ben yomo o tumtum veanderoginus o akkum noten ma shehu sheve dinar o elef keillu hu eved hannimkar bashshuk: 
Vehaarachim kullan vehaddamim hakkol setaman levedek habbayit veyippelu hakkol lallishka shehayta bammikdash muchenet lekadshe bedek habbayit: 
Akkum sheamar damay alay o deme peloni alay noten kefi nidro veeno nofel lallishka sheen mekabbelin min haakkum nedava o neder lechazzek et bedek habbayit o bedek yerushalayim shenneemar <small>(Ezra 4 3)</small> "lo lachem valanu livnot bayit" vegomer. veneemar <small>(Nechemya 2 20)</small> "velachem en chelek utzedaka vezikkaron birushalayim": 
Uma yaase bahen. yibbadek haakkum al daat mi nadar. im nadar al daat yisrael yotziuhu bet din bema sheyyerae lahem chutz mibbedek habbayit uvedek yerushalayim. veim amar lashshamayim nadarti yigganzu: 
Haggoses en lo lo erech velo damim hoil verov haggossin lemita hare hu kemet. vechen mi shennigmar dino bevet din shel yisrael lehargo al avera sheavar veheericho acher o sheheerich atzmo o sheamar damay alay o sheamar acher deme ze alay eno chayyav kelum shezze kemet hu vehammet en lo erech velo damim. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 27 29)</small> "kol cherem asher yochoram min haadam lo yippade" kelomar en lo pidyon ella hare hu kemet: 
Ze hayyotze lehareg sheheerich acherim o nadar demehem o hizzik chayyav leshallem vegovin hakkol minnechasav: 
Kohanim uleviyyim maarichin veneerachin kishar yisrael. vekatan shehiggia leonat nedarim veheerich o nadar damim chayyav leshallem shehare nedarav kayyamim kemo shebbearnu behilchot nedarim: 
Haarachin hakketzuvin lefi hashshanim hen shene hanneerach velo shene hammaarich. ketzad. ben esrim sheamar leven shishshim erkecha alay noten erech ben shishshim. uven shishshim sheamar leven esrim erkecha alay noten erech ben esrim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Vetzarich hammaarich sheyyehe piv velibbo shavin kishar hannedarim. venishalin al haarachin veal haddamim kederech shennishalin al shear nedarim vehekdeshot: 
Haomer erech ellu alay noten erech kullan kol echad veechad lefi shanav. veim haya ani noten al yede kullam erech echad ani. veim haya ashir noten al yede kullan erech ashir: 
Haomer erki alay vechazar veamar erki alay vechen im amar afillu kamma peamim chayyav al kol achat veachat. amar shene erki alay noten shene arachin. vechen im amar arbaa afillu elef noten kamminyan shennadar: 
Amar hare alay erech velo peresh erech mi ella erech setam noten pachut shebbaarachin shehu sheloshet shekalim: 
Haomer erki alay umet kodem sheyyaamod bedin en hayyorshin chayyavin litten. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 8)</small> "veheemido lifne hakkohen veheerich oto hakkohen". amad baddin umet yittenu hayyorshin: 
Aval haomer damay alay af al pi sheamad bedin umet kodem sheyyiktzetzu damav veyomru haddayyanin kamma yishve en hayyorshin chayyavin litten. veim katzvu damav veachar kach met yittenu hayyorshin: 
Uma ben arachin ledamim. shearachin ketzuvin min hattora vehaddamim enan ketzuvin. vechen haomer erech peloni alay umet haorech vehanneerach achar sheamad hanneerach bedin chayyavin hayyorshin litten. met hanneerach kodem sheamad bedin af al pi shehammaarich kayyam hare ze patur. sheen erech lemet vehanneerach tzarich amida bedin. amar deme peloni alay veamad bedin umet kodem sheyyiktzetzu damav hare ze patur sheen damim lammetim:

Haomer erech yadi o erech eni o ragli alay o sheamar erech yad ze o eno alay lo amar kelum. erech libbi o kevedi alay o erech libbo shel peloni o kevedo alay noten erech kullo. vechen kol evar sheim yinnatel min hachay yamut im amar erko alay noten erech kullo: 
Amar chatzi erki alay noten chatzi erko. erech chetzyi alay noten erech kullo shei efshar sheyyinnatel chetzyo veyichye: 
Haomer deme yadi alay o deme yad peloni alay shamin oto kamma hu shave beyad vechamma hu shave belo yad venoten lahekdesh. ketzad. im nimkar hu kullo [yihye] shave chamishshim. veim yimmacher chutz miyyado shettishshaer yado zo livalav velo yihye lallokeach bah kelum shave arbaim. nimtza ze yitchayyev leshallem lahekdesh asara. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haomer deme roshi o kevedi alay o deme rosho shel peloni alay o libbo o kevedo alay noten deme kullo. vechen haomer deme chetzyi alay noten deme kullo. aval haomer chatzi damay alay noten chatzi damav: 
Haomer mishkali alay o mishkal peloni alay noten mishkalo im kesef kesef im zahav zahav kemo shepperesh. amar mishkal yadi o ragli alay roin kamma hi reuya lishkol venoten mamon shepperesh. ad hechan hi hayyad leinyan ze ad heatzil veharegel ad haarkubba lefi shebbindarim holchin achar leshon bene adam: 
Haomer komati alay kesef o zahav noten sharvit sheeno nichpaf melo komato mimmin shepperesh. amar melo komati alay noten afillu sharvit shennichpaf mimmin shepperesh: 
Haomer mishkali alay velo peresh mee ze min. im haya ashir beyoter venitkavven lemattana merubba noten mishkalo zahav. vehu haddin beomer mishkal yadi o ragli o komati velo peresh mee ze min noten zahav. veim eno muflag baashirut noten mishkalo o mishkal yado middevarim sheddarkan lehishshakel beoto makom afillu perot. vechen noten sharvit melo komato afillu shel etz hakkol lefi mamono vedato: 
Haomer amdi alay yeshivati alay o mekom yeshivati alay o rachbi alay avyi alay hekkefi alay kol ellu safek umevi lefi mamono. ad sheyyomar lo kach nitkavvanti. veim met yittenu hayyorshim pachut shebballeshonot: 
Haomer hare alay matbea kesef lo yifchot middinar kesef. matbea nechoshet lo yifchot mimmaa kesef. hare alay barzel lo yifchot meamma al amma lechale orev shehaya lemala begag hahechol kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Haomer hare alay kesef o zahav velo hizkir matbea yavi lashon shel kesef o shel zahav yihye mishkalah ad sheyyomar lo lechach nitkavvanti. vechen im peresh hammishkal veshachach kamma peresh yavi ad sheyyomar lo lechach nitkavvanti: 
Echad haomer damay alay o deme peloni alay. o haomer hare alay mane o chamishshim o kesef o zahav. hakkol hen hannikraim chayyave damim. vehaddamim vehaarachin levedek habbayit kemo shebbearnu: 
Shete leshachot hayu bammikdash. achat lishkat chashaim. veachat lishkat hakkelim. lishkat chashaim yire chet notnin letochan bachashay vaaniyyim bene tovim mitparnesim mimmenna bachashay. lishkat hakkelim kol mi shehitnaddev keli zorko letochah veachat lishloshim yom haggizbarin potchin otah. kol keli shennimtza bo tzorech levedek habbayit mannichin oto vehashshear nimkarin udemehen noflin lelishkat bedek habbayit: 
Hutzrechu lekadshe mizbeach velo hispiku lahen terumat hallishka motziin et harauy lahen mikkadshe bedek habbayit. aval im hutzrechu levedek habbayit velo matzu belishkat bedek habbayit davar hammaspik lahen en motziin harauy lahen mikkadshe hammizbeach:

Hammaarich et happachut mibben esrim velo amad bedin ad shehaya yeter al esrim eno noten ella erech pachut mibben esrim. sheen haerech ella bizman haerech lo bizman hahaamada baddin: 
Kol haarachin hakketzuvin battora hen shennoten hammaarich im haya ashir. aval im haya ani veen yado masseget noten kol hannimtza beyado afillu sela echad veniftar shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 8)</small> "veim mach hu meerkecha" <small>(Vayikra 27 8)</small> "al pi asher tassig yad hannoder": 
Uminnayin shehu noten afillu sela echad im en lo ella sela echad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 25)</small> "vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh" ha lamadta sheen baarachin pachot missela velo yoter al chamishshim: 
Hare shello nimtza beyado afillu sela en lokchin mimmennu pachot missela. ella yishshaer hakkol alav chov veim matza yado veheeshir yitten erech shalem hakkatzuv battora: 
Ashir sheheerich veheeni. o sheheerich keshehu ani veheeshir. hare ze chayyav beerech ashir. aval im heerich keshehu ani veheeshir vechazar veheeni noten erech ani: 
Ashir sheamar erki alay o erech peloni veshama heani veamar ma sheamar ze alay. hare heani chayyav beerech ashir shehu erech shalem. aval ani sheheerich et heashir veamar erech ze alay eno chayyav ella keerech ani shehu kefi asher tassig yado: 
Ma ben hachayyav beerech ani lehachayyav beerech ashir shehu haerech hakkatzuv kullo. shehachayyav beerech ani shellakchu mimmennu kol ma sheyyado masseget afillu sela echad veachar kach heeshir eno chayyav leshallem. veim haya chayyav beerech ashir yishshaer shear haerech chov alav ad sheyyaashir veyashlim haerech shealav: 
Hamefaresh et haerech veamar erki alay chamishshim selaim. o erech peloni alay sheloshim selaim. eno niddon behesseg yad. ella lokchin kol hannimtza beyado vehashshear alav chov ad sheyyaashir veyitten: 
Vechen haomer damay alay o deme peloni alay eno niddon behesseg yad. shechayyave damim hare pershu nidran vahare hen kemi sheamar mane alay hekdesh shehu chayyav litten mane gamur: 
Haomer hare alay erech setam velo peresh eno kimfaresh sheloshet shekalim ella niddon behesseg yad kishar hammaarichin: 
Haomer erki alay vechazar veamar erki alay vehayu beyado eser selaim venatan tesha lashsheniyya vesela larishona yatza yede shetehen. shehaarachin lav kechovot hen. sheaf al pi shekkol ma shebbeyado meshubad larishona. hekdesh meuchar sheggava gava. aval im natan tesha larishona veachat lashsheniyya yede sheniyya yatza. shehare keshennatan hassela lo nishar beyado kelum vahare en yado masseget. yede rishona lo yatza. shehare kol ma shehaya beyado meshubad larishona keshennatan hattesha nishar lo sela vahare lo natan kol ma sheyyado masseget. lefichach yishshaer alav shear erech rishon ad sheyyaashir veyashlim: 
Haomer shene arachay alay velo haya beyado ella pachot mikkede shene arachin. hare haddavar safek im nitpas lishnehen venoten chatzi ma sheyyesh lo leerech echad vachatzi laerech hashsheni veyippater o yitten erech echad mehen shalem o kol hannimtza beyado beechad mehen veyishshaer haerech haacher alav chov ad sheyyitten oto baaniyyut o baashirut kefi hesseg yado: 
Hammafrish erko o damav venignevu o avdu af al pi shello amar alay chayyav beacharayutan ad sheyyaggiu leyad haggizbar. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 23)</small> "venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu kodesh laAdonai" hare hen chullin af al pi shehifrishan ad sheyyaggiu lide haggizbar: 
Chayyave arachin vedamim memashkenin otan velokchin mehen baal karchan ma shennadru veenan chayyavin lehachezir lahem hammashkon bayyom o ballayla. umochrin kol hannimtza lahem min hakkarka umin hammittaltelin mikkesut uchele tashmish habbayit vaavadim uvehema venifrain min hakkol. veen mochrin lo kesut ishto velo kesut banav velo begadim shetztzevaan lishman velo sandalim chodashim shellekachan lishman. vechen hammakdish kol nechasav lo hikdish et ellu: 
Venotnin lo mikkol nechasav laze sheyyesh alav arachin o damim o shehikdish mane levedek habbayit veen lo. notnin lo tefillin shel rosh veshel yad vesandalav vechisse leshev alav umitta umatztza haruyin lo lishon alehem. veim haya ani notnin lo mitta umappatz lishon alav. venotnin lo mezon sheloshim yom uchesut shenem asar chodesh lo levaddo aval lo leishto uvanav af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotehem uvichsutam. veen notnin lo ella kesut haruya lo: 
Hayu alav kele meshi uvegadim muzhavin maavirin otan mealav venotnin lo kesut haruya leish kemoto lechol aval lo leshabbatot veyamim tovim: 
Veim haya umman notnin lo shene kele ummenut mikkol min umin. ketzad. im haya charash notnin lo shene matzadim ushete megerot. hayu lo kelim merubbin mimmin echad umuatin mimmin sheni en mochrin min hamerubbe velokchin lo min hammuat. ella notnin lo shene kelim min hamerubbin vechol sheyyesh lo min hammoat: 
Haya chammar o ikkar en notnin lo behemto af al pi sheen lo mezonot ella mimmenna. haya sappan en notnin lo sefinato ella yimkor hakkol: 
Hayu bannechasim behema vaavadim umargaliyyot veamru hattaggarim im yillakach leeved ze kesut bishloshim mashbeach hu mea. ufara zot im yamtinu bah laitlis mashbachat asara. umargalit zo im maalin otah lemakom peloni tishve mamon rav vechan enah shava ella meat. en shomin lahen. ella ketzad osin. mochrin hakkol bimkomo uvishato kema shehu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 23)</small> "venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu kodesh laAdonai" lerabbot kol davar shel hekdesh sheen mefarkesin oto veen mamtinin bo lashshuk velo molichin oto mimmakom lemakom. en lahekdesh ella mekomo usheato: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemittaltelin vaavadim. aval hakkarkaot machrizin alehem shishshim yom retzufim babboker uvaerev veachar kach mochrin otam:

Sade sheyyerashah adam mimmorishav hi hannikret sede achuzza. vesade shellekachah o zacha bah hi hannikret sede mikna. vehammakdish sede achuzzato moddin otah veerkah hu haerech hakkatzuv battora: 
Vechamma hu. kol makom sherauy lizroa bo chomer seorim veyizraennu bayyad velo yekarev zeriato velo yerachek otah. erko chamishshim shekalim lechol shene yovel. veen shenat yovel min hamminyan. veechad hammakdish sade tova sheen bechol eretz yisrael kemotah. o sade raa sheen kamoha leroa. kaze maarichin oto: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot shekalim shehashshekel haamur battora hu hannikra sela bilshon chachamim. vehaggera haamura battora hi hammaa bedivre chachamim vehosifu al hashshekel veasu oto sela. vehassela arbaa dinarin. vehaddinar shesh main. vehammaa shene punedyonin. nimtza lechol shana sela ufunedyon. sheaf al pi shehassela shemona vearbaim punedyonin. kesheyyitten punedyonot likkach sela min hashshulchani noten tisha vearbaim: 
Hachomer hu hakkor. vehu shene letachin. vehalletech chamesh esre sein. nimtza hachomer sheloshim sea shehen eser efot kol shalosh sein efa. uchevar bearnu behilchot shabbat shehammakom sheyyesh bishvoro chamishshim amma al chamishshim amma hu bet sea vehu mizra sea. nimtzeta lamed shehammakom sheyyesh bishvoro chamishsha veshivim elef amma shehu beribbua matayim arba veshivim ammot al matayim arba veshivim ammot bekeruv hu bet kor vehu <small>(Vayikra 27 16)</small> "zera chomer seorim": 
Ketzad derech hacheshbon beerche sadot. hare shehikdish sede achuzzato venishar layyovel shemone shanim chutz mishshenat hayyovel sheenah bacheshbon kemo shebbearnu. kol harotze lifdotah miyyad hekdesh noten lechol <small>(Vayikra 27 16)</small> "zera chomer seorim" shemona selaim ushemone punedyonot. veim ratzu habbealim lifdotah notnin eser selaim vaasara punedyonot lefi shehen mosifin chomesh. vechen kol chomesh haamur battora tzarich sheyyehe hakkeren im hattosafot chamishsha nimtza shehosif revia hakkeren. vechen im padta ishto shel makdish o echad miyyorshav hare ellu mosifin chomesh: 
Nishar layyovel arba shanim noten happode arba selaim vearbaa punedyonot lechol chomer veim habbealim padu otah noten chomesh. vechen lefi cheshbon ze sela ufunedyon lechol shana. veeno noten shana beshana ella noten hakkol keechad: 
Nishar beno uven hayyovel shana eno yachol litten sela ufunedyon lifdotah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 18)</small> "vechishshav lo hakkohen" <small>(Vayikra 27 18)</small> "al pi hashshanim hannotarot" enah nifdet begiron kesef ella kodem layyovel bishte shanim o yoter: 
Nishar beno uven hayyovel shana vechodashim im ratza haggizbar lachshov hechodashim shana veyitten shenayim shekalim ushenayim punedyonim lechol zera chomer hare ze muttar. lefi sheen mechashshevin chodashim lahekdesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 18)</small> "al pi hashshanim hannotarot". shanim atta mechashshev lahekdesh vee atta mechashshev chodashim: 
Lefichach en rauy leadam lehakedish sadehu lifne hayyovel befachot mishshete shanim. veim hikdishah hare zo mekuddeshet. veenah nifdet begiron kesef ella im ratza happode litten chamishshim shekel lechol chomer pode otah veim lo pedaah hare zo yotza lakkohanim bayyovel kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hikdish sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah enah mekuddeshet. vechohen velevi shehikdishu bishnat hayyovel atzmah hare zo mekuddeshet: 
Keshem sheggoalin leolam kach makdishin leolam: 
Hammakdish et sadehu achar hayyovel enah nifdet begiron kesef ad sheyyiggamer shana achar hayyovel. lefi sheen mechashshevin chodashim lahekdesh. lefichach im ratza happode litten chamishshim shekel lechol zera chomer hare ze pode afillu bayyom sheachar hayyovel veeno gorea kelum: 
Keshemmoddin en moddin ella mekomot haruyin lizria. hayu sham selaim gevohim asara tefachim o nekaim meleim mayim amukim asara tefachim en nimdadin immah. pachot mikkan nimdadin immah: 
Hayu bah mekomot nemuchot asara o yoter veen bahen mayim nimdadin bifne atzman umechashshevin lahem ma sherauy lahem: 
Hayta melea ilanot af al pi shello peresh hare hikdish gam hailanot shekkol hammakdish beayin yafa hu makdish umechashshevin et hailanot beshavyehen vehakkarka moddin otah veyihye erkah sela ufunedyon lechol shana ulechol zera chomer kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammakdish et hassade sheenah reuya lizria vehi hannikret terashin podin otah beshavyah. vechen hammakdish et hailanot bilvad podin otan beshavyehen: 
Hayu hailanot shelosha ilanot letoch bet sea velo peresh shehailanot bilvad hu shehikdish hare ze hikdish et hakkarka veet hailanot shebbenehen. aval im hayu hailanot netuim kol shelosha ilanot beyeter mibbet sea o befachot o shehikdishan ze achar ze hare ze lo hikdish et hakkarka velo et hailanot shebbenehem: 
Hikdish hailanot veachar kach hikdish et hakkarka pode et hailanot beshavyehen veet hakkarka al pi middatah: 
Hammakdish sede achuzzato vehiggia hayyovel velo nifdet ella hare hi tachat yad hakkodesh. hakkohanim notnin et dameha vetihye achuzza lahem. sheen hekdesh yotze belo pidyon. veotan haddamim yippelu lehekdesh bedek habbayit: 
Gealah hammakdish kodem sheyyaggia hayyovel hare zo chozeret livaleha vehaerech shennatan yippol levedek habbayit kemo shebbearnu. vechen im gealah beno shel makdish hare zo chozeret leaviv bayyovel. aval im gaala otah bitto o shear kerovav o nachri miyyad hahekdesh. im chazar hammakdish ugealah miyyadan chozeret lo leolam. veim lo gealah miyyadan ella higgia hayyovel vehi tachat yad habbat o shear kerovim o nachri hare zo yotza lahekdesh veenah chozeret labbealim leolam. ella tihye achuzza lakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 21)</small> "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel lakkohen" vegomer. veen hakkohanim tzerichin litten damim shekkevar nifdet miyyad hahekdesh velakach erkah meuchar ella tachzor lakkohanim keillu hem bealeha: 
Bamme devarim amurim beyisrael. aval im haya hammakdish kohen o levi hare ze goel leolam. vaafillu avar aleha hayyovel velo nifdet min hahekdesh pode otah achar hayyovel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 32)</small> "geullat olam tihye lalviyyim": 
Haishsha shehikdisha sede achuzzatah ugealah balah miyyad hahekdesh vehiggia hayyovel vehi tachat yad habbaal hare haddavar safek im tachzor laishsha o tetze lakkohanim. lefichach kadma haishsha vehechezika bah achar hayyovel en hakkohanim yecholin lehotzi miyyadah. vechen im kadmu hakkohanim vehecheziku bah enah yechola lehotzi miyyadam: 
Hammakdish sadehu ufada otah kohen miyyad hahekdesh vehiggia hayyovel vehi tachat yad hakkohen lo yomar hoil vahare hi yotza lakkohanim hare hi tachat yadi vezachiti bah ella yotza lechol echav hakkohanim: 
Keshettetze hassade lakkohanim bayyovel tinnaten lakkohanim shebbammishmar sheppaga bo hayyovel. veim haya rosh hashshana shel yovel beshabbat shehare mishmar yotze umishmar nichnas tinnaten lammishmar hayyotze: 
Hammakdish et hailanot vehiggia hayyovel velo padu otam enan yotzin lakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 21)</small> "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel" veen ellu sade. aval hammakdish et hatterashim vehiggia yovel velo padu otan habbealim hare ellu yotzin lakkohanim shenneemar vehaya hassade vezo nikret sade: 
Ketzad din makdish sede miknato. shamin otah bedameha veroin kamma hi shava ad hayyovel ufode otah kol mi sheyyirtze. veim pada otah hammakdish eno mosif chomesh ufidyonah levedek habbayit kishar arachin vedamim. uchesheyyaggia hayyovel tachzor labbealim harishonim shemmecharuha. ben shennifdet miyyad haggizbar vahare hi yotza miyyad acher. ben shello nifdet vahare hi yotza miyyad hahekdesh hare zo chozeret lammocher veenah yotza lakkohanim sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello: 
Kol sade sheshshamin otah lahekdesh limkor otah bedameha machrizin aleha shishshim yom retzufin babboker bishat hachenasat poalim uvaerev bishat hotzaat poalim. umesayyemin metzareha veomer kach hi yafa uvechach hi shuma kol harotze likkach yavo veyikkach: 
Hallokeach sade meaviv o mishshear hammorishin oto vehikdishah. ben shehikdishah achar mot aviv o morisho. uven shehikdishah bechayye aviv o shear morishav veachar kach met aviv hare zo kisde achuzza. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 22)</small> "veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza yatzat zo sheruya lo leyorshah:

Hammakdish sede achuzzato mitzva alav lifdotah hu shehaadon kodem. veim lo ratza en kofin oto. bamme devarim amurim bizman shemmitzvat yovel noheget sheim yaggia yovel velo yigalenna tetze lakkohanim kemo shebbearnu. aval bizman shebbatlu hayyovlot shehare enah yotzet lakkohanim ella sofah lehippadot leolam kofin et haadon liftoach bah techilla vehi nifdet beshavyah kishar hahekdeshot. im nimtza mi shemmosif alav vegoel otah yigal veim lav omrin lo higgiatcha veyitten ma sheamar veeno poteach befachot mearba perutot kede sheyyehe hachomesh shemmosif peruta: 
Ratza haadon limkor sadot acherot missedotav o lilvot kede lifdot sade zo shehikdish harshut beyado. ben bizman shehayyovel noheg ben bizman sheen hayyovel noheg. vehu kodem lechol adam. vechen im ratza ligl chetzyah goel. ma sheen ken bemocher lehedyot. ze chomer behedyot mibbehekdesh: 
Hammakdish et beto o et behema temea shello o shear mittaltelav hare ellu neerachin beshavyehen ben tov uven ra. veim pada otan hammakdish o ishto o yorsho mosif chomesh. vechofin et habbealim liftoach rishon vehaddamim levedek habbayit. ben shehaya habbayit mibbatte are choma ben shehaya mibbatte hachatzerim hare ze nigal leolam: 
Gealo acher miyyad hahekdesh im haya bet are choma vekam beyad haggoel shenem asar chodesh nechlat. veim haya bet hachatzerim vehiggia hayyovel vehu beyad haggoel chozer livalav bayyovel: 
Hammakdish behema tehora temima levedek habbayit af al pi sheavar al ase ma sheasa asuy vechala kedushsha aleha venifdet keshehi temima. umaarich otah hakkohen bedameha. vehaddamim yippelu levedek habbayit. veen happode otah pode ella al menat lehakerivah lammizbeach lema shehi reuya. shekkol davar harauy lammizbeach eno yotze mide mizbeach leolam: 
Uminnayin sheasur lehakedish temimin levedek habbayit shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 23)</small> "veshor vase sarua vekalut nedava taase oto". mippi hashshemua lamdu nedava levedek habbayit. vechen haddevarim marin sheenah ella kedushshat damim. sheen makrivin baal mum lammizbeach shenneemar oto <small>(Vayikra 22 23)</small> "oto" atta ose nedava levedek habbayit veen atta ose temimim nedava levedek habbayit. velav habba mikkelal ase kaase hu: 
Hammakdish et behemto setam o shehikdish et nechasav setam roin kol behema temima haruya lehakeriv al gabbe hammizbeach zecharim yimmachru letzarche olot veyakrivu otan olot. vehannekevot yimmachru letzarche shelamim veyakrivu otan shelamim. vehaddamim yippelu levedek habbayit shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 27 9)</small> "veim behema asher yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai yihye kodesh" kelomar kol harauy lekarban al gabbe hammizbeach yikkarev: 
Hikdish nechasav setam vehayu bahen yenot ushemanim uselatot veofot haruyin likkarev al gabbe hammizbeach yimmachru letzarche oto hammin veyakrivu otan vehaddamim yillakach bahen zecharim veyakrivu olot: 
Umippene ma yakrivu deme ellu olot udeme habbehema hattemima yippelu levedek habbayit. lefi shehabbehema hakkedosha lammizbeach im nafal bah mum yesh lah pidyon kemo sheyyitbaer vehassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen vehaofot shennifselu en lahen pidyon shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 11)</small> "veheemid et habbehema" vegomer kol sheyyeshno bichlal haamada vehaaracha yesh lah pidyon vechol sheeno bichlal haamada vehaaracha en lah pidyon: 
Hikdish nechasav setam vehayta bahen hakketoret shennotnin leammanin bischaran ad sheyyachzeru veyikchu otah kemo shebbearnu bishkalim. hare zo tinnaten leammanin bischaran kemo sheosin bemotar hakketoret. vechen osin im yesh binchasav echad missammane hakketoret: 
Hammakdish behema temima lammizbeach venafal bah mum venifsela hare zo neerechet venifdet. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 27 11)</small> "veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai veheemid et habbehema" vegomer. veyavi bedameha karban acher kemotah: 
Kol hammakdish behema bechayyeha ben tehora ben temea ben kadshe habbayit ben kadshe mizbeach shennafal bahen mum o temima haruya likkarev kemo sheyyitbaer hare zo tzericha haamada bevet din shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 11)</small> "veheemid et habbehema". lefichach im meta habbehema kodem shettearech vetippade en podin otah achar shemmeta ella tikkaver. aval im hikdish shechuta o nevela levedek habbayit hare zo tippade kishar mittaltelin: 
Shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim vaadayin hi mefarkeset hare hi kechayya lechol devareha veneerechet vahare hi bichlal veheemid veheerich ad shettamut: 
Hammakdish behema temima ledameha hare zo nitkaddesh gufah. ketzad. haomer deme behema zo hekdesh lammizbeach hi atzmah tikkarev. hikdish echad meevareha ledamav veamar deme raglah shel para zo hekdesh lammizbeach hare zo safek im pashta kedushsha bechullah o lo pashta. ulefichach tikkarev velo tippade: 
Vketzad osin. mochrin otah kullah lemi sheyyakriv otah. vedameha chullin chutz middeme oto evar. veim haya evar shehanneshama teluya bo pashta kedushsha bechullah: 
Hayta behema baalat mum sheenah reuya likkarev vehikdish evar meevareha ledamav ben shehanneshama teluya bo ben shehanneshama en teluya bo lo nitkaddesh ella deme oto evar bilvad. ketzad. kegon sheamar deme regel para zo o deme libbah hekdesh lammizbeach. hu vehekdesh shuttafin bah: 
Vechen haomer rosh eved ze o lev chamor ze hekdesh lammizbeach o sheamar roshi hekdesh lammizbeach eno chayyav ella bidme rosho veroin kamma yishve oto evar illu haya nimkar veyavi bedamav karban: 
Bamme devarim amurim bekadshe mizbeach. aval bekadshe bedek habbayit haomer deme rosh chamor ze o kevedo hekdesh o deme rosh eved ze o kevedo hekdesh hoil vehu davar shehanneshama teluya bo hare ze chayyav bidme kullo. shekkol hekdesh bedek habbayit kedushshat damim hu: 
Haomer erki alay lammizbeach mevi beerko karban. veim en yado masseget leerech shalem hare ze devar safek im niddon behesseg yad hoil vehotzio bilshon erech. o eno niddon behesseg yad hoil velammizbeach nadar. vechen hammakdish sede achuzzato lammizbeach hare zo nifdet vehaddamim yaviu bahen olot lammizbeach. veyesh baddavar safek im podin otah baerech hakkatzuv bah o podin otah beshavyan hoil velammizbeach hikdish vedanin bechol ellu vechayyotze bahen lehachemir:

Echad haomer hare ze hekdesh levedek habbayit o cherem levedek habbayit o cherem lashshamayim. vechen bechol nechasav im amar kol nechasav hekdesh o cherem levedek habbayit o cherem lashshamayim hare ellu yippelu levedek habbayit. aval im amar cherem setam hare ellu lakkohanim. shessetam charamim lakkohanim. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 14)</small> "kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye":

Machrim adam min bekaro umitztzono umeavadav umishshifchotav hakkenaanim umissede achuzzato. aval lo yacharim kol behemto velo kol avadav velo kol sedotav velo kol min sheyyesh lo mishshear hammittaltelin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "mikkol asher lo". veim hecherim et hakkol afillu hecherim kol nechasav hare ellu muchramin ben shehechrim lakkohanim ben shehecherim levedek habbayit:
Vechol mi shehecherim o hikdish kol nechasav lokchin kol ma sheyyesh lo vaafilu tefillin shebberosho. veen tzarich lomar kele ummenuto uvegadav shehakkol hekdesh o cherem:

Ma ben cherme kohanim lecherme shamayim. shecherme shamayim hekdesh venifdin beshavyehen veyippelu haddamim levedek habbayit veyetzu hannechasim lechullin. vecherme kohanim en lahen pidyon leolam ella nittanin lakkohanim kitruma. veal cherem kohanim hu omer <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "lo yimmacher velo yiggael". lo yimmacher leacher velo yiggael labbealim:

Veechad hammacharim karka o mittaltelin hare ellu nittanin lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar. beshaa shehecherim cherme kohanim kol zeman shehen bevet habbealim hare hen hekdesh lechol divrehem. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai". netano lakkohen hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 14)</small> "kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye":

Kohen shehayta lo sede cherem shezzacha bah achar hayyovel vehecherimah hare zo muchremet veyotza leechav hakkohanim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 21)</small> "lakkohen tihye achuzzato" melammed shessede chermo lo kisde achuzza leyisrael sheim hecherimah hi muchremet miyyad:

Machar hakkohen sede chermo vehikdishah lokeach afillu haya hallokeach habbealim harishonim shehecherimuha hare zo kisde mikna vechozeret lakkohen shemmecharah bayyovel. aval karka o mittaltelin shel kohanim uleviyyim enam machrimin otan shehare omer besade <small>(Vayikra 25 34)</small> "ki achuzzat olam hu lachem". umittaltelin hukkeshu lekarkaot bacharamin shenneemar <small>(gemara arachin koach 1)</small> "mikkol asher lo umissede achuzzato":

Hammakdish kadshe mizbeach levedek habbayit hare hahekdesh chal alehen vetearech habbehema vetippade veyippelu dameha levedek habbayit vehabbehema tikkarev lema shehayta battechilla. aval hammakdish kadshe bedek habbayit lammizbeach veamar hare ze ola o shelamim o hecherimam lakkohanim lo asa kelum veen hekdesh mizbeach velo hacherem chal al kadshe bedek habbayit sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello:

Haomer shor ze hekdesh leachar sheloshim yom ushechato betoch sheloshim yom hare ze muttar bahanaa. hikdisho lammizbeach hare ze hekdesh lammizbeach. aval im amar hare ze hekdesh meachshav leachar sheloshim yom ushechato betoch sheloshim yom hare ze asur bahanaa. veim hikdisho betoch hashsheloshim lammizbeach eno mukdash:
Hammakdish ola levedek habbayit en bah ella ikkuv gizbarin bilvad. umiddivre sofrim shello tishshachet ad shettippade. lefichach im avar ushechatah hare zo keshera:

Macharim adam ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim ben cherme kohanim ben cherme bedek habbayit. veim hayu kadashim shehu chayyav beacharayutan noten et demehen ben lakkohanim ben levedek habbayit veyikkarvu otan hakkadashim achar sheyyippadu lema shehen:
Hayu nedava vehecheriman ketzad podin otan. omdim kamma adam rotze litten bivhema zo lehaalotah ola sheeno chayyav bah. vechol hannoten oto shiur yakriv behema zo nedava kemo shehayta:
Yisrael shehechrim et bechor behema lashshamayim ben shehaya tamim ben shehaya baal mum hare ze muchram. veen tzarich lomar shehechrimo hakkohen lashshamayim achar shebba leyado:

Vechetzad podin otan. omdin kamma adam rotze litten bivchor ze kede sheyyihye lo vetihye harshut beyado litteno lechol kohen sheyyirtze likrovo o lereo. vechol hannoten oto shiur yikkach habbechor veyittenennu lechol kohen sheyyirtze veyippelu haddamim levedek habbayit:
Hammacharim et hammaaser hare ze kemacharim shalme nedava lefi sheeno chayyav beacharayuto:
Hammakdish shiklo levedek habbayit hare ze kodesh. hikdish bikkurim levedek habbayit enan kodesh. aval im hikdishan hakkohen achar shebbau leyado hare ellu kodesh:

Hammacharim chatzi avdo veshifchato hu vehakkohanim shuttafin bo. aval im hikdish o hecherim lashshamayim chatzi avdo kullo kodesh kemo shebbearnu. vechol hammakdish avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim o hammakdish kol nechasav vehayu bahen avadim hare gufan kodesh lefichach asurim lehanot bahen ad sheyyippadu:
Veen haggizbarin rashshain likkach demehen meacherim ulehotzi otan lecherut ella mochrin otan laacherim vaacherim motziin otan lecherut im ratzu:

Hammakdish yede avdo kol hayyeter al parnasato kodesh. vechetzad hu mitparnes eved ze. love veochel veose uforea. vehu sheyyaase pachot pachot mishsheve peruta veyifra. sheim asa bifruta rishon rishon kana hekdesh:
Hammakdish et atzmo lo hikdish ella damav vahare hu chayyav bidme atzmo. umuttar lo laasot veleechol shehare lo nitkaddesh gufo keeved:
En adam makdish davar sheeno shello. ketzad. kegon shehechrim beno uvitto veavdo veshifchato haivrim o sede miknato hare ellu enan muchramin. sheen adam makdish davar sheen gufo shello:

En adam makdish davar sheeno birshuto. ketzad. haya lo pikkadon beyad acher vechafar bo ze shehu etzlo en habbealim yecholin lehakedisho. aval im lo kafar bo hare hu birshut bealav bechol makom shehu:

Bamme devarim amurim bemittaltelin. aval karka sheggezalah acher vechafar bah im yachol lehotziah bedayyanin hare ze yachol lehakedishah veaf al pi sheadayin lo hotziah shehakkarka atzmah hare hi birshut bealeha:
Haggozel et chavero velo nityaashu habbealim shenehem enan yecholin lehakedish. ze lefi sheeno shello veze lefi sheeno birshuto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shehaya mocher deluin o betzim vechayyotze bahen uva lokeach venatal achat vehalach lo. im hayu deme kol achat veachat ketzuvin hare ze kemi sheppasak. veen hammocher yachol lehakedish delaat zo shehare enah birshuto. veim en haddamim ketzuvin vehikdishah mekuddeshet sheadayin birshuto hi shezze shellekachah lo lekachah derech gezela. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
En adam makdish davar shello ba laolam. ketzad. ma shettaale metzudati min hayyam kodesh. ma shettotzi sade zo min happerot cherem. lo amar kelum:
Haomer lachavero sade zo shemmacharti lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha mekuddeshet ulekachah enah mekuddeshet. lefi shekkeshehikdishah lo baa birshuto:

Vechen hammakdish maase yede ishto hare zo osa veochelet vehammotar chullin. amar lah yikdeshu yadayich leosehen hoil vehen meshubadin lo hare kol maase yadeha kodesh. ha lema ze dome leomer ilan ze kodesh shekkol perot sheyyaase lehabba kodesh. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haomer lachavero sade zo sheani mocher lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha titkaddesh hare zo mekuddeshet kesheyyikkachenna shehare atta (ba) beyado lehakedishah. sade zo shemmishkanti lecha lichsheefdenna mimmecha tehi kodesh. mishsheyyifde otah titkaddesh shehare beyado lifdotah. vaafillu hayta memushkenet lizman katzuv shehare beyado lifdotah achar hazzeman:
Hammaskir bayit lachavero vechazar vehikdisho hare ze kodesh ufaka hassechirut. veim dar bo hassocher maal:

Yerae li sheaf al pi sheen adam makdish davar shello ba laolam im amar hare alay lehakedisho hare ze chayyav lehakedisho kesheyyavo laolam mishshum nidro. veim lo hikdish hare ze over mishshum <small>(Devarim 23 22)</small> "bal teacher" v<small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" umishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase" kishar hannedarim:

Ketzad. haomer hare alay lehakedish kol shettaale metzudati min hayyam. hare alay litten laaniyyim perot shettotzi sade zo. hare alay lehacharim o litten lishvuyim kol sheestakker beshana zo. vechol kayyotze bemaamarim ellu hare ze chayyav litten velaasot bahen ma sheamar kesheyyavou leyado. veze vechayyotze bo bichlal nedarim hu lo bichlal hekdeshot:

Reaya ledavar ze ma sheamar yaakov avinu <small>(Bereshit 28 22)</small> "vechl asher titten li asser aasserennu lach" veneemar <small>(Bereshit lo 13)</small> "asher nadarta li sham neder". vahare haomer lo eppater min haolam ad sheeheye nazir chayyav linhog binzirut veaf al pi sheadayin lo nadar benazir. hoil veamar sheyyiddor benazir chayyav lehinnazer. veze kayyotze bo vechaze rauy ladun:

Hekdesh taut eno hekdesh. ketzad. haomer shor shachor sheyyetze mibbayit rishon hare hu hekdesh veyatza lavan eno hekdesh. dinar zahav sheyyaale beyadi rishon hare hu hekdesh veala shel kesef eno hekdesh. chavit shel yayin shettaale beyadi rishona hekdesh veala shel shemen ben shehayyayin yakar min hashshemen beoto makom o hashshemen yakar min hayyayin eno hekdesh. hitpis bah acheret veamar zo kazo hare hashsheniyya hekdesh. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hahekdeshot en podin otan lo bekarka. velo baavadim shehare hukkeshu lekarkaot. velo bishtarot (mippene) sheen gufan mamon shenneemar venatan et hakkesef. echad hakkesef veechad shear hammittaltelin sheshshavin kesef. vaafilu subbin: 
Kol happode kadashav mosif chomesh. veechad hammakdish atzmo o ishto o hayyoresh mosifim chomesh kemo shebbearnu. veaf hachomesh lo yihye ella min hammittaltelin. vehachomesh shemmosif hare hu kehekdesh atzmo vedin echad lahem: 
Happode kadashav en hachomesh meakkev. ella meachar shennatan et hakkeren yatza hakkodesh lechullin umuttar lehanot bo. umiddivre sofrim sheasur lo lehanot ad sheyyitten hachomesh shemma yifsha velo yitten. aval beshabbat mippene oneg shabbat hittiru lo leechol veaf al pi sheadayin lo natan et hachomesh vahare haggizbarin tovin oto: 
Kadshe mizbeach shennafal bahem mum venifdu. im pada hammakdish atzmo mosif chomesh kishar hahekdeshot. vehammakdish sheppada leatzmo hu shemmosif chomesh lo hammitkapper bah sheppedaah. vehekdesh rishon hu shechayyav betosefet chomesh. aval hekdesh sheni eno mosif alav chomesh. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 15)</small> "veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit". hammakdish velo hammatpis: 
Lefichach im chillel behema al behema sheniyya ben bekadshe bedek habbayit ben bekadshe mizbeach shennafal bahem mum. o shehemir bekadshe mizbeach. keshehu pode et hashsheniyya shechillel aleha o et hattemura leatzmo eno mosif chomesh: 
Hammafrish asham lehitkapper bo venafal bo mum vehosif alav chomesh vechillelo al behema acheret venitkapper beasham acher venitteka habbehema shechillel aleha liriyya kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. hare hu safek im mosif aleha chomesh hoil vehu karban ola vahare hu guf echad ukedushsha acheret. o eno mosif aleha chomesh mippene shehi baa mikkoach hekdesh rishon shekkevar hosif alav chomesh: 
Kadshe bedek habbayit en osin temura shello dana tora bitmura ella bekadshe mizbeach. ketzad. hayu lefanav behemat chullin uvehemat kadshe bedek habbayit veamar zo chalufat zo o zo temurat zo lo amar kelum. aval im amar hare zo tachat zo hare zo mechullelet al zo devarav kayyamin veyatzta habbehema harishona lechullin venitpesa hashsheniyya: 
Echad kadshe bedek habbayit veechad kadshe mizbeach shennafal bahen mum en podin otan lechattechilla ella beshavyehen. veim avar vechillelan al pachot mishshavyehen afillu hekdesh shave mea dinar shechillelo al sheve peruta hare ze paduy veyatza lechullin umuttar lehanot bo. umiddivre sofrim shehu tzarich chakirat damim vechayyav lehashelim et damav: 
Ketzad. hayta lo behemat kadshe mizbeach shennafal bah mum vahare hi shava asara uvehemat chullin sheshshava chamishsha veamar hare zo mechullelet al zo hare zo nifdet veyatzat lechullin aval tzarich lehashelim hachamishsha. vechen im hayta habbehema harishona kadshe bedek habbayit hare zo yatzat lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved vetikkanes hashsheniyya tachteha din tora. aval middivrehem tzarich chakirat damim im hayta zo shechillel aleha shava o yashlim dameha: 
Shamu otah shelosha veamru shezzo bedameha afillu bau achar ken mea veamru shel kodesh hayta yafa eno chozer. hoil vachakirat haddamim middivrehem lo hechmiru bah. aval im shamu otah shenayim uvau shelosha veamru shehona hahekdesh bechol shehu chozer: 
En podin et hahekdesh achsara ella bachakirat damim kemo shebbearnu. veim pada yad hekdesh al haelyona. ketzad. para zo tachat para zo shel hekdesh tallit zo tachat tallit zo shel hekdesh. hekdesho paduy veyad hekdesh al haelyona. im hayta hashsheniyya yafa min harishona beyoter lokchin otah haggizbarin veshotkin. veim enah yafa meshallem et haddamim kemo shebbearnu umosif chomesh. aval im amar tallit zo beeser selaim tachat tallit shel hekdesh ufara zo beeser selaim tachat para zo shel hekdesh. afillu hayta shel hekdesh shava chamesh veshello eser hare ze mosif chomesh venoten shete selaim umechetza shehare bedamim ketzuvim pada. usheniyya enah teuna chomesh kemo shebbearnu: 
Happode miyyad hahekdesh mashach bemane velo hispik litten haddamim ad sheamad bematayim noten matayim shenneemar venatan et hakkesef vekam lo. bintinat hakkesef hu shello. meshacho bematayim velo hispik litten et haddamim ad sheamad bemane noten matayim. lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hekdesh. vahare kana bimshicha venitchayyev baddamim: 
Pada bematayim venatan haddamim velo hispik lemashcho ad sheamad bemane kevar kana bintinat hakkesef umoshech et shello vezacha hekdesh bematayim. padahu bemane venatan haddamim velo hispik lemashcho ad sheamad bematayim ma sheppada paduy veeno noten ella hammane shekkevar natan. veen omrin kan lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hekdesh. sheafillu hedyot eno yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyekabbel mi sheppara kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo veen hekdesh rauy lekabbel mi sheppara: 
Hammakdish kol nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha o shitre baale chovot. en haishsha yechola ligbot ketubbatah min hahekdesh velo baal chov et chovo. shehahekdesh mafkia hashshibud shekkadam. aval kesheyyimkor hahekdesh hakkarka shello vetetze hassade lechullin yesh levaal chov uleishsha ligbot min happode shehare shibudah omed al karka zo: 
Ha lema ze dome lishne lakochot shekkatva larishon din udevarim en li immecha umachar lashsheni shehi torefet min hashsheni: 
Vechetzad podin karka ze. mashbiin et haishsha o baal chov techilla kederech kol habba lippara minnechasim meshubadim veachar kach machrizin alehem shishshim yom babboker uvaerev kemo shebbearnu. veomdin kamma adam rotze litten bassade al menat litten leishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo. veachar sheppodin otah velokeach otah hallokeach afillu bedinar kede shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidyon. chozer happode umagbe laishsha ketubbatah o labbaal chov et chovo. afillu haya hachov mea vehassade shava tishim al menat kach pode otah harotze lifdotah. aval im haya hachov shenayim bidme hassade kegon shehayta shava mea veyesh alav chov uchetubbat ishsha matayim en podin otah al menat litten hachov o hakketubba ella podin otah setam sheim hitnu litten enah nifdet kelal: 
Hammakdish kol nechasav veachar kach geresh et ishto vegavta ketubbatah min happode min hahekdesh eno gove ad sheyyaddirenna hanaa. shemma kenuneya asu al hahekdesh. veen omrin illu ratza haya omer betaut hikdashti veyishshael al hekdesho lechacham veyachzor lo: 
Vechen en neeman lomar achar shehikdish mane lifloni chov alay o keli ze shel peloni hu. shemma yaasu kenuneya al hahekdesh. vaafillu haya shetar beyad baal chov eno gove al pi ze ella kederech sheggovin kol baale chovot kemo shebbearnu: 
Bamme devarim amurim bevari. aval chole shehikdish kol nechasav veamar beshaa shehikdish mane lifloni beyadi neeman. sheen adam ose arma al hahekdesh bishat mitato vechote laacherim shehare hu holech lamut. lefichach im amar tenu otah lo notel belo shevua. veim lo amar tenu en notnin ella im ken haya beyado shetar mekuyyam. hare ze notel min hahekdesh mippene hatztzavvaa. veim achar shehikdish amar tenu en shomin lo ella hare hu kishar baale chovot. im nitkayyem shetaro nishba vegove min happode velo min hahekdesh: 
Mi sheyyatza alav kol shehifkir et nechasav o hikdishan o hecheriman en choshshin lo ad shettihye sham reaya berura:

Bachamisha asar baadar bet din nifnin lechappes velivdok al tzarche tzibbur veal inyene hahekdeshot. uvodkin alehen vedorshin vechokrin ufodim et hahekdeshot veet hacharamin vegovin et haarachin veet haddamim mikkol hachayyav bahen kede sheyyihye kol haam atid litten terumat hashshekalim lechazzek et bet elohenu: 
En podin et hahekdeshot ella bishlosha bekiin. vechen kesheggovin mittaltelin shemmemashkenin mechayyave arachin shamin otan bishlosha. ucheshemmaarichin behema vechayyotze bah mishshear mittaltelin shamin otah bishlosha. aval keshemmaarichin et hakkarkaot o im huzkeku ligbot erche adam min hakkarka shello en maarichin otan ella baasara veechad mehen kohen shehare <small>(Vayikra 27 8)</small> "kohen" katuv bapparasha. vechen haomer damay alay o deme peloni alay o deme yadi o ragli alay kesheshshamin oto kamma hu shave o kamma deme yado o raglo shamin baasara veechad mehen kohen: 
Kesheppodin hahekdeshot miyyad hahekdesh ben shehayu karkaot o mittaltelin machrizin alehen bifne kol habbain lifdot. amar echad hare hen shelli beeser selaim veamar echad beesrim veamar echad bishloshim veamar echad bearbaim veamar echad bachamishshim. chazar bo shel chamishshim levaddo memashkenin minnechasav eser venotnin otan hahekdeshot laze shennatan arbaim venimtza hahekdesh notel chamishshim eser mizze vearbaim mizze. chazar bo achare ken shel arbaim memashkenin minnechasav eser venotnin et hahekdesh levaal hashsheloshim vechen ad harishon. chazar bo harishon shennatan eser machrizin al hahekdesh paam sheniyya umochrin oto. im nifda befachot meeser nifrain mishshel baal haeser et hammotar: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshechazru ze achar ze. aval chazru kullan keechad meshalleshin benehem beshave. ketzad. amar harishon hare hu shelli beeser veamar hashsheni beesrim veamar hashshelishi bearbaa veesrim vechazar bo hashshelishi vehashsheni keechad notnin oto larishon beeser. umemashkenim minnichse hashsheni besheva uminnichse shelishi besheva venimtza hahekdesh gove arba veesrim. vechen im chazru shelashtan keachat venimkar hahekdesh beshalosh memashkenin minnichse kol echad mishshelashtan sheva selaim. vechen al derech zo leolam: 
Habbealim kodmin lechol adam mippene shehen mosifin chomesh. veen mosifin chomesh al illuyan shel shear happodim ella al ma shennatnu hem techilla. ketzad. amru habbealim hare ze shellanu beesrim uva acher veamar hare hu shelli beesrim habbealim kodmin mippene shehen mosifin chomesh venotnin chamesh veesrim. ba echad veamar hare hu shelli beachat veesrim im shatku habbealim velo hosifu kelum mochrin otah lahem bechamesh veesrim. veim hosifu habbealim al esrim veachat afillu peruta achat hare ellu notnin shesh veesrim uferuta achat. achat veesrim uferuta shennatnu meatzman vechamesh shehen chayyavin bo mishshum chomesh hammattan shennatnu techilla. vechen im ba hashsheni veamar hare hu shelli beesrim ushetayim. uva shelishi veamar beesrim veshalosh. uva revii veamar beesrim vearba. uva hachamishi veamar beesrim vechamesh. vehosifu hen al haesrim vechamesh afillu peruta achat kofin otan litten sheloshim uferuta. chamesh veesrim uferuta shennatnu meatzman. vechamesh mechomesh shehen chayyavin bo. lefi sheen habbealim mosifin chomesh al illuyo shel ze ella chomesh ma shennatnu techilla mosifin al ma shennatan haacharon im ratzu: 
Bamme devarim amurim shello shamu hahekdesh shelosha mumchin. aval im shamu oto shelosha mumchin veamru shehu shave ma shennatan haacharon vehosifu habbealim al illuyo afillu peruta achat hare hen mosifin chomesh al illuyo shel acharon venotnin achat usheloshim vedinar uferuta: 
Hare shello nishshom hahekdesh. venatnu habbealim techilla esrim uva acher venatan chamesh veesrim veshatku habbealim velo hosifu kelum. habbealim kodmin sheaf hen chayyavin litten chamesh veesrim mippene hachomesh. ba acher venatan shesh veesrim hu kodem. veim ratzu habbealim vehosifu afillu peruta notnin achat usheloshim uferuta kemo shebbearnu. veal derech zo leolam: 
En makdishin velo maarichin velo machrimin bazzeman hazze sheen sham mikdash bachataenu kede lechazzek et bidko. veim hikdish o heerich o hecherim im hayta behema noel delet befaneha ad shettamut meeleha. veim hayu perot o kesut o kelim mannichin otan ad sheyyerakvu. veim hayu maot o kele mattachot yashlichen leyam hammelach o layyam haggadol kede leabbedan: 
Hikdish o hecherim eved shennichnas lemitzvot podehu veyelchu damav leyam hammelach kishar damim vaarachin shel zeman hazze. veim haya eved akkum lo maalin velo moridin: 
Muttar lifdot hahekdeshot bazzeman hazze lechattechilla vaafilu bifruta umashlich otah leyam hammelach. vachachamim danu sheyyifde bearbaa zuzim o karov laze kede lefarsem haddavar. aval bizman hammikdash lo yifde lechattechilla ella beshavyo kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shehechrim bazzeman hazze mittaltelin setam hare ellu notnan lakkohanim hannimtzain beoto makom. aval im hecherim sade beeretz yisrael setam o shehecherimah lakkohanim enah cherem. sheen sede charamim noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg. hecherim lakkohanim karka bechutz laaretz vaafillu bazzeman hazze hare hi kemittaltelin baaretz yisrael vetinnaten lakkohanim: 
Af al pi shehahekdeshot vehacharamin vehaarachin mitzvot verauy lo leadam lehanehig atzmo bidvarim ellu kede lachof yitzro velo yihye kilay vikayyem ma shetztziuu neviim <small>(Mishlei 3 9)</small> "kabbed et Adonai mehonecha". af al pi chen im lo hikdish velo heerich velo hecherim meolam en bechach kelum. hare hattora heida veamra <small>(Devarim 23 23)</small> "vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet": 
Leolam lo yakdish adam velo yacharim kol nechasav. vehaose ken over al daat hakkatuv shehare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 27 28)</small> "mikkol asher lo" velo kol asher lo kemo shebbearu chachamim. veen zo chasidut ella shetut shehare hu meabbed kol mamono veyitztarech labberiyyot. veen merachamin alav. uvaze vechayyotze bo amru chachamim chasid shote mikkelal mevalle olam. ella kol hamefazzer mamono bemitzvot al yefazzer yoter mechomesh. veyihye kemo shetztziuu neviim <small>(Tehillim 112 5)</small> "mechalkel devarav bemishpat" ben bedivre tora ben bedivre olam. afillu bekarbanot sheadam chayyav bahen hare chasa tora al hammamon veamra sheyyavi kefi missat yado. kal vachomer lidvarim shello nitchayyev bahen ella mechamat nidro shello yindor ella karauy lo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 17)</small> "ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach":
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 1:
Hazzorea shene mine zeraim keechad beeretz yisrael loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "sadcha lo tizra kilayim": 
Veechad hazzorea o hamenakkesh o hamechappe kegon shehayta chitta achat useora achat o pol echad vaadasha achat munnachin al haaretz vechippa otan beafar ben beyado ben beraglo ben bichli hare ze loke. veechad hazzorea baaretz o beatzitz nakuv. aval hazzorea beatzitz sheeno nakuv makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Asur lizroa kilayim lenachri. umuttar lomar lenachri lizroa lo kile zeraim. veasur leadam lekayyem kile zeraim besadehu ella okran veim kiyyeman eno loke. umuttar leyisrael lizroa kile zeraim beyado bechutza laaretz vaafillu learev hazzeraim lechattechilla ulezaran bechutza laaretz muttar udevarim ellu divre kabbala: 
En asur mishshum kile zeraim ella hazzeraim haruyin lemaachal adam. aval asavim hammarim vechayyotze bahen min haikkarin sheenan reuyin ella lirfua vechayyotze bahen en bahen mishshum kile zeraim: 
Kile hailanot hare hem bichlal ma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 19)</small> "sadcha lo tizra kilayim". ketzad. hammarkiv ilan bailan kegon shehirkiv yichur shel tappuach beetrog o etrog betappuach hare ze loke min hattora bechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. vechen hammarkiv yarak beilan o ilan beyarak loke bechol makom: 
Veasur leyisrael lehaniach lenachri sheyyarkiv lo ilanot kilayim. umuttar lizroa zeraim vezera ilan keechad vechen muttar learev zare ilanot ulezaran keechad sheen lecha kilayim bailanot ella harekava bilvad: 
Hazzorea zeraim kilayim vechen hammarkiv ilanot kilayim af al pi shehu loke hare ellu muttarin baachila vaafillu laze sheavar uzeraan shello neesar ella zeriatan bilvad. umuttar litta yichur min hailan shehurkav kilayim velizroa mizzera hayyarak shennizra kilayim: 
Hazzeronin nechelakin lishlosha chalakim. haechad mehem hu hannikra tevua vehi chamishsha minin hachittim vehakkussemin vehasseorin veshibbolet shual vehashshifon. vehashsheni mehen hu hannikra kitnit. vehen kol zeraim hanneechol leadam chutz min hattevua. kegon happol vehaafunim vehaadashim vehaddochan vehaorez vehashshumshemin vehapperagin vehassappir vechayyotze bahen. vehashshelishi mehen hu hannikra zerone ginna. vehen shear zeronin sheenan reuyin lemaachal adam. vehapperi shel oto hazzera maachal adam. kegon zera habbetzalim vehashshumin vezera hechatzir vehakketzach vezera lefet vechayyotze bahen. vezera pishtan hare hu bichlal zerone ginna. kesheyyizaru kol mine zeronim ellu veyitzmechu nikra hatztzemach kullo kol zeman shello nikkar hazzera deshe venikra yerek: 
Veyesh mizzerone ginna zeronim sheddarkan lizroa mehen sadot kegon happishtan vehachardal veellu hen hannikraim mine zeraim. veyesh mizzerone ginna zeronim sheen derech bene adam lizroa mehem ella arugot arugot ketannot kegon hallefet vehatztzenon vehatteradim vehabbetzalim vehakkusbar vehakkarpas vehammaror vechayyotze bahen veellu hen hannikraim mine yerakot:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 2:
Zera shennitarev bo zera acher im hayu echad meesrim vearbaa kegon sea shel chittim shennitarva beesrim veshalosh sea shel seorim hare ze asur lizroa et hameorav ad sheyyemaet et hachittin o yosif al hasseorim veim zara loke: 
Vechol shehu kilayim im hazzera mitztaref leechad meesrim vearba. ketzad. esrim veshalosh sea shel chittim shennitarev bah shene kabbin seorim ushene kabbin adashim ushene kabbin polim hare ze lo yizra hakkol ad sheyyemaet sea shel taarovet veyavor miktzatah o yosif al hachittim. shehasseorim vehaadashim vehappol kullam kilayim im hachittim: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshennitarvu mine tevua ze baze o mine kitniyyot ze baze o shennitarva tevua bekitniyyot o kitniyyot bitvua. aval zerone ginna shennitarev echad mehen bitvua o bekitniyyot shiuran echad meesrim vearbaa mimma shezzorin bevet sea meoto hammin im nitarev bisa shel tevua o kitnit lo yizra ad sheyyemaet o yosif al hattevua: 
Ketzad. chardal shennitarev bitvua vahare hachardal zorin mimmennu kav bechol bet sea im nitarev mimmennu echad meesrim vearbaa min hakkav bisa shel tevua o shel kitnit chayyav lemaet. vechen im haya min ze mizzerone ginna zorin mimmennu satayim bechol bet sea im nitarev mimmennu chatzi kav bechol sea shel tevua o shel kitnit yemaet: 
Lefichach tevua shennitarev bah zera pishtan im haya sheloshet reviim bechol sea hare ze yemaet. veim lav eno tzarich lemaet. lefi shebbet sea zorin bo shalosh seim zera pishtan. veal derech ze meshaarim bechol hazzeraim haacherim: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshello nitkavven learev uveshello nitkavven lizroa hashshene minin shennitarvu. aval im nitkavven learev zera bezera acher o lizroa hashshene minin afillu hayta chitta achat betoch keri shel seorim asura lezarah. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hazzorea sadehu min min hamminin uchesheyyitzmach raa bo kilayim. im haya hammin haechad echad meesrim vearbaa bassade hare ze yilkot ad sheyyemaatennu mippene marit haayin. shemma yomru kilayim zara bechavvana. ben shehaya hammin haechad shetztzamach tevua vekitnit bitvua vekitnit. o zerone ginna bitvua vekitnit uvezerone ginna. veim haya hatztzomeach pachot mikkan eno tzarich lemaato: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyesh makom lachashad. aval bizman shehaddevarim marin sheen ze middato shel baal hassade ella mealehen alu en mechayyevin oto lemaet: 
Ketzad. kegon tevua shealu bah sefiche istis vetiltan shezzeraah lemaachal adam shealu bah mine asavim shezze mafsid hu. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Uvema yivvada shehattiltan zerua lemaachal adam. keshehayta zerua arugot arugot velah gevul saviv. vechen mekom haggoranot shealu bah minin harebe en mechayyevin oto laakor. shehare haddavar yadua sheeno rotze sheyyitzmach tzemach bimkom haggoranot. veim hesir miktzatan omrin lo akor hakkol chutz mimmin echad shehare gilla dato sherotze bekiyyum hashshear: 
En notin yerakot betoch saddan shel shikma vechayyotze bah. hattomen aguddat lefet utzenon vechayyotze bah tachat hailan afillu tachat haggefen. im hayu miktzat healin megullin eno choshesh shehare eno rotze behasherashatan veim enan agudda o shello hayu healin megullin choshesh mishshum kilayim: 
Sade shehayta zerua vekatzar hazzera venisharu haikkarin baaretz af al pi sheen motziin tzemach ella achar kamma shanim lo yihye zorea beotah sade min acher ad sheyyaakor haikkarin: 
Hayta sadehu zerua chittim venimlach lezarah seorim kodem sheyyitzmechu hachittim. yamtin lah ad sheyyippasdu hachittim veyatliu baaretz kemo shelosha yamim im hayta sadehu rava veachar kach yehappecheha bemachresha veyizra hammin haacher. veeno tzarich lehappech et kullah ad shello tishshaer chitta shello neekra ella choresh et hassade kederech shechorshin otah kodem hammatar kede shettirve: 
Tzamchu hachittim veachar kach nimlach lezarah seorim yahafoch veachar kach yizra. veim horid behemto letochah vekirsema et hatztzemach hare ze muttar lizroa sham min acher: 
Beechad baadar mashmiin al hakkilayim. vechol adam yotze leginnato ulesadehu umenakkin oto min hakkilayim. uvachamishsha asar bo yotzim sheluche bet din umesabbevim livdok: 
Barishona hayu okrin umashlichin vehayu baale battim semechim shemmenakkin lahen sedotehen. hitkinu sheyyihyu mafkirin et kol hassade sheyyimtzeu bo kilayim. vehu sheyyimtzeu bah min acher echad mearbaa veesrim aval pachot mikkan lo yiggeu bah: 
Vechozrin sheluche bet din bechullo shel moed happesach lirot haafil sheyyatza. vechilayim shehenetztzu en mamtinim lahen ella yotzin alehen miyyad umafkirin et kol hassade im yesh bah echad meesrim vearbaa:
Mishneh Torah, Diverse Species 3:
Yesh minin bazzerain sheyyihye hammin haechad nifrad letzurot harebe mippene shinnuy mekomot vehaavoda sheovdin haaretz ad sheyyerae kishne minin veaf al pi sheen domin ze laze hoil vehen min echad enan kilayim ze baze: 
Veyesh bazzeraim shene minin shehen domin ze laze vetzurat shenehen kerova lihyot tzura achat veaf al pi chen hoil vehen shene minin hare ellu asurim ze im ze: 
Ketzad. hachazeret im chazeret gallim. vehaelshin im elshe sade. vehakkereshin im kereshe sade. hakkusbar im kusbar harim. vechardal im chardal mitzri. udelaat hammitzrit im delaat harmutza enan kilayim ze baze. vechen hachittin im hazzunin. vehasseorim im shibbolet shual. vehakkussemin im hashshifon. vehappol im hassappir. vehappurkedan im hattofach. ufol lavan im hashsheuim. vehakkeshut im hammelaffon. vehakkeruv im hatterovtor. vehatteradin im halleunin enan kilayim ze im ze. aval hatztzenon im hannefusin. vehachardal im hallafsan. udelaat yevanit im delaat mitzrit o im delaat harmutza af al pi sheddomim ze laze hare ellu kilayim ze baze: 
Vechen beilan sheyyesh shene minin sheddomin ze laze baalin o bapperot hoil vehen shene minin hare ellu kilayim. ketzad. hattappuach im hachizrad. vehapparsekin im hashshekedim. vehashshezafin im harimin af al pi sheddomin ze laze hare hen kilayim ze baze. aval haagassim im hakerusetmalim vehapperishim im haezradin enan kilayim ze baze: 
Vechen im yesh sham zeraim veilanot acherot af al pi shehen shene minin betivan hoil vealin shel ze domin lealin shel ze o peri shel ze dome lifri shel ze dimyon gadol ad sheyyerau kishne gevanin mimmin echad lo chashshu lahen lechilayim ze im ze sheen holchin bechilayim ella achar marit haayin: 
Ketzad. hallefet im hatztzenon enan kilayim ze baze mippene sheppiryehen shavin. vehallefet im hannefus enan kilayim ze baze mippene shehealin shellahen shavin. aval tzenon im hannefus af al pi shehealin domin ze laze vehapperi dome lapperi hare ellu kilayim hoil vetaam peri ze rachok mittaam peri ze beyoter. vechen kol kayyotze beellu: 
Kamma marchikin ben shene mine zeraim shehen kilayim ze im ze. kede sheyyihyu nirim muvdalin ze mizze. aval im nirin shennizreu beirbuveya hare ze asur: 
Veshiurin rabbim yesh beharechaka hazzot hakkol lefi godel hassade hannizraat ulefi rov healin veshilluach hayyonkot: 
Ketzad. sadehu shehayta zerua min tevua uvikkesh lizroa betziddah min tevua acheret besade achat marchik benehen bet rova vehu keeser ammot vechomesh amma al eser ammot vechomesh amma merubba ben min haemtza ben min hatztzad. veim lo haya benehen kashshiur hazze asur veeno loke ad sheyyihyu kerovin betoch shishsha tefachim: 
Hayta sadehu zerua yarak uvikkesh lizroa betziddah sede yarak acher afillu delaat marchik ben shete hassadot shishsha tefachim al shishsha tefachim merubba ben min hatztzad ben min haemtza. ufachot mishshiur ze asur veeno loke ad sheyyihyu kerovin betoch tefach: 
Hayta achat mishshete hassadot zerua tevua vehashsheniyya shebbetziddah yarak o delaat marchik benehen bet rova: 
Bamme devarim amurim shetztzarich leharechaka bashshiurin hallalu ben shete sadot. aval im hayta sadehu zerua yarak veratza lizroa betziddah shura shel yarak mimmin acher dayyo laasot ben hassade uven hashshura telem echad arko shishsha tefachim bilvad verachbo keamko:
