Haomer sheshshechachuhu poalim velo shechacho baal hassade. shechacho baal hassade velo shechachuhu poalim. shechachuhu ellu veellu vehayu sham acherim ovrin veroin otan beet sheshshechachuhu. enah shichcha ad sheyyishkechuhu kol adam. vaafillu omer hattamun im nishkach hare ze shichcha: 
Haya baal hassade bair veamar yodea ani shehappoalim shachchu omer shebbemakom peloni ushechachuhu hare ze shichcha. veim haya bassade veamar ken ushechachuhu enah shichcha shehashshachuach meikkaro bassade hu hashshichcha. aval bair afillu zachur ulevassof shachuach hare zo shichcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 19)</small> "veshachachta omer bassade" velo bair: 
Amdu haaniyyim befanav o chippuhu bekash vehu zocher et hakkash o shehechezik bo leholicho lair vehinnicho bassade ushechacho eno shichcha. aval im netalo mimmakom lemakom af al pi shehinnicho samuch laggappa o laggadish o labbakar o lakkelim ushechacho hare ze shichcha: 
Natal omer leholicho lair vehinnicho al gabbe chavero veshachach et shenehen. im zachar haelyon kodem sheyyifga bo en hattachton shichcha veim lav hattachton shichcha: 
Afu omarav beruach chazaka letoch sede chavero veshachach sham omer eno shichcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 19)</small> "ketzircha vesadecha". aval im pizzer hoomarim betoch sadehu veshachach hare zo shichcha: 
Hannotel omer rishon vesheni ushelishi veshachach harvii. im haya sham shishshi en harvii shichcha ad sheyyittol hachamishi. veim hayu chamishsha bilvad mishsheyyishhe kede littol hachamishi hare harvii shichcha: 
Shene omarim meurbavin veshachach echad mehen enah shichcha ad sheyyittol et kol sevivotav: 
Halluf vehashshum vehabbetzalim vechayyotze bah af al pi shehen temunin baaretz yesh lahen shichcha. hakkotzer ballayla veshachach kama o sheimmer ballayla veshachach omer vechen hassuma sheshshachach yesh lahen shichcha. veim haya hassuma o hakkotzer ballayla mitkavven littol et haggas en lo shichcha. vechol haomer hareni kotzer al menat ma sheani shocheach ani ettol yesh lo shichcha shekkol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel: 
Tevua shekketzarah ad shello nigmera lehaachilah livhema. vechen im ketzarah aguddot ketannot velo asaah omarim. vechen hashshumim vehabbetzalim shettelashan aguddot ketannot lehimmacher lashshuk velo asaan omarim lehaamid mehen goren en lahem shichcha: 
Hakkotzer shehitchil liktzor merosh hashshura veshachach lefanav uleacharav. shel acharav shichcha veshellefanav eno shichcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 19)</small> "lo tashuv lekachto" eno shichcha ad sheyyaavor mimmennu veyannichennu leacharav. ze hakkelal kol shehu beval tashuv shichcha vechol sheeno beval tashuv eno shichcha: 
Shenayim shehitchilu liktzor meemtza hashshura ze panav letzafon veze panav ledarom veshachchu lifnehem uleacharehen. shellifnehem shichcha. mippene shekkol echad mehen ze shellefanav hu laachorav shel chavero. vehaomer sheshshechachuhu laachorehen bemakom shehitchilu mimmennu eno shichcha. mippene shehu meorav im hashshurot shemmin hammizrach lemaarav vehen mochichin alav sheeno shachuach. vechen hashshurot shel omarim sheppinu otan legoren vehitchilu shenayim meemtza shura veshachchu omer baemtza ben achorehen eno shichcha mippene shehu beemtza hashshura shemmin maarav lammizrach sheadayin lo hitchilu bah vehi mochachat alav sheeno shachuach: 
Hakkotzer veillem alummot alummot. ufinna haalummot vehen hannikrain omarim mimmakom ze lemakom acher. umimmakom hashsheni lammakom hashshelishi. umimmakom hashshelishi laggoren veshachach haomer beshaa sheppinna mimmakom lemakom. im pinna hoomarim lemakom shehu gemar melacha ushechachah yesh lo shichcha uchesheyyefanne mimmakom shehu gemar melacha laggoren en lo shichcha. veim pinna hoomarim lemakom sheeno gemar melacha veshachach eno shichcha uchesheyyefanne mimmakom sheeno gemar melacha laggoren yesh lo shichcha: 
E zehu makom shehu gemar melacha. ze makom sheddato lekabbetz kol hoomarin sham veladush otan sham o leholichan sham limkom gadish shehu haggoren. umakom sheeno gemar melacha hu hammakom shemmekabbetzin bo hoomarim kede laasot mehen alummot gedolot kede leholichan lemakom acher: 
Shete kerichot hammuvdalot zo mizzo shichcha. veshalosh enan shichcha. shene omarim hammuvdalin ze mizze shichcha. ushelosha enan shichcha: 
Shene tzibbure zetim vecharuvin hammuvdalin ze mizze shichcha. ushelosha enam shichcha. shene hutzene pishtan shichcha ushelosha enam shichcha: 
Shete gefanim vechen bishar hailanot shenayim hammuvdalin ze mizze shichcha. ushelosha enan shichcha shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 10)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23 22)</small> "leani velagger taazov otam" afillu hayu shenayim echad leani veechad lagger: 
Hayu kol hoomarim shel kav kav veechad shel arbaa kabbin ushechacho hare ze shichcha. yeter al haarbaa eno shichcha. vechen im hayu shel shene shene kabbin veechad yeter al shemona kabbin eno shichcha: 
Haomer sheyyesh bo satayim ushechacho eno shichcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 19)</small> "veshachachta omer bassade" velo gadish af al pi shekkullan satayim satayim. shachach shene omarim af al pi sheyyesh mishshenehen satayim hare ellu shichcha. vechen yerae li shehen shichcha afillu haya bishnehen yoter missatayim: 
Kama sheyyesh bah satayim ushechachah enah shichcha. en bah satayim roin et hashshibbolim haddakkot keillu hen beriot vaarukkot veet hashshedufot keillu hen meleot. veim hayta reuya (lihyot) hakkama achar umdan ze laasot satayim ushechachah enah shichcha: 
Shachach sea tevua akura usea sheenah akura enan mitztarfim. ushenehem shichcha. vechen beshum uvivtzalim uveferot hailan im shachach miktzatan bakkarka umiktzatan talush uvishnehem satayim enan mitztarfin ella shenehem shichcha 
Hashshocheach omer betzad hakkama sheenah shechucha enah shichcha. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 19)</small> "ki tiktzor veshachachta omer". omer shessevivotav katzir shichcha aval omer shessevivotav kama enah shichcha. vechen im shachach kama betzad kama sheenah shechucha afillu kelach echad hare zo matztzelet et hashshechucha veyihye muttar lekachtah. aval im shachach omer o kama betzad omer sheeno shachuach afillu haya bo satayim eno matztzil otah vahare hashshachuach laaniyyim. en kamat chavero matztzelet al omer shello veen kamat seorim matztzelet al omer chittim ad shettihye hakkama mimmin haomer: 
Hashshocheach ilan ben hailanot afillu haya bo kamma sein perot o sheshshachach shene ilanot hare hen shichcha. shelosha enan shichcha: 
Bamme devarim amurim beilan sheeno yadua umefursam bammakom kegon shehaya omed betzad haggat o betzad happirtza. o bemaasav kegon shehaya ose zetim harebe. o bishmo kegon shehaya lo shem yadua kegon zayit hannetufa ben hazzetim shehu notef shemen harebe o hashshafchani o habbeyshani. aval im haya bo echad mishshelosha devarim ellu eno shichcha. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 19)</small> "veshachachta omer bassade" omer sheatta shochcho leolam veen atta yodea bo ella im tashuv vetirehu. yatza ze sheatta zochro leachar zeman veaf al pi shello tifga bo mippene shehu yadua umefursam: 
Haya mesuyyam bedato hare ze kimfursam veyadua. haya omed betzad haddekel haddekel mesayyemo. hayu shenehen zayit netufa ze mesayyem et ze. hayta kol sadehu zayit netufa veshachach achat mehen o shetayim yesh lo shichcha. bamme devarim amurim shello hitchil beilan ze hamefursam. aval im hitchil bo veshachach miktzato hare ze shichcha. veaf al pi shehu mefursam. vehu sheyyihye hannishar bo pachot missatayim. aval satayim enah shichcha ella im ken shachach kol hailan kemo shebbearnu: 
Zayit haomed beemtza hashshurot levaddo veshalosh shurot shel zetim makkifin oto mishshelosh ruchotav af al pi sheen bechol shura mehen ella shene zetim shachach et haemtzai eno shichcha. shehare hashshurot histiruhu. velamma amru zayit bilvad mippene shehaya chashuv beeretz yisrael beoto hazzeman: 
Ezehu shichcha bearis. kol sheeno yachol lifshot et yado velittelah. uvecherem mishsheyyaavor min haggefen (o) umin haggefanim veyishkach otah. bedalit uvedekel mishsheyyered hemennu. ushear kol hailanot mishsheyyifne veyelech lo. bamme devarim amurim shello hitchil bo. aval im hitchil bo ushechacho enah shichcha ad sheyyivtzor et kol sevivav: 
Hammafkir et karmo vehishkim babboker vezacha bo leatzmo uvetzaro chayyav beferet uveolelot uveshichcha uvefea shehare sadcha vecharmecha ani kore bo mippene shehaya shello vahare hu shello. aval im zacha min hahefker besade shel acherim hare ze patur min hakkol. uven kach uven kach patur min hammaasrot kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 6:
Mattanna acheret shishshit yesh laaniyyim bezera haaretz vehu hammaaser shennotnin laaniyyim vehu hannikra maasar ani: 
Vezehu seder terumot umaasrot. achar shekkotzer zera haaretz o osef peri haetz vetiggamer melachto mafrish mimmennu echad min hachamishshim. vezehu hannikra teruma gedola venotnah lakkohen. veal ze neemar battora <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "reshit degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha". veachar kach mafrish min hashshear echad measara. vezehu hannikra maaser rishon. venotno lallevi. veal ze neemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 18 24)</small> "ki et masar bene yisrael" vegomer veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 21)</small> "velivne levi hinne natatti et kol maaser beyisrael": 
Veachar kach mafrish min hashshear echad measara vehu hannikra maaser sheni. vehu livalav veochlin oto birushalayim. vealav neemar <small>(Vayikra 27 lo)</small> "veim gal yigal ish mimmaasro". vealav neemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "asser teasser" <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar": 
Al hasseder hazze mafrishin beshana rishona min hashshavua uvashsheniyya uvarviit uvachamishit. aval bashshelishit uvashshishshit min hashshavua achar shemmafrishim maaser rishon mafrish min hashshear maaser acher venotno laaniyyim vehu hannikra maasar ani. veen bishte shanim ellu maaser sheni ella maasar ani. vealav neemar <small>(Devarim 14 28)</small> "miktze shalosh shanim totzi et kol masar tevuatcha bashshana hahi vehinnachta bisharecha" <small>(Devarim 14 29)</small> "uva hallevi". vealav neemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "ki techalle laser": 
Shenat hashshemitta kullah hefker veen bah lo teruma velo maasrot kelal lo rishon velo sheni velo maasar ani. uvechutza laaretz sheen bah shemittat karka mafrishin beeretz mitzrayim uveammon uvemoav maaser rishon umaasar ani. mippene shehaaratzot ellu kerovot leeretz yisrael kede sheyyehyu aniyye yisrael nismachin aleha bashsheviit. vahalacha lemoshe missinay sheyyihyu mafrishim beeretz ammon umoav maasar ani bashsheviit. aval beeretz shinar mafrishin bashsheviit maaser sheni keseder rov hashshanim: 
Maaser rishon shellakach hallevi mafrish mimmennu echad measara venotno lakkohen vehu hannikra terumat maaser. vealav neemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 26)</small> "veel haleviyyim tedabber": 
Baal hassade sheavru alav aniyyim vehaya lo sham maasar ani. noten lechol ani sheyyaavor alav min hammaaser kede savo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "veachlu visharecha vesaveu": 
Kede savo kamma. im min hachittim noten lo yifchot mechatzi kav. veim min hasseorim lo yifchot mikkav. veim min hakkussemin lo yifchot mikkav. umin haggerogarot lo yifchot mikkav. veim min haddevela lo yifchot mimmishkal chamesh veesrim sela. veim min hayyayin lo yifchot mechatzi log. veim min hashshemen lo yifchot merviit. veim min haorez rova hakkav. natan lo yarak noten lo mishkal litra vehu mishkal chamishsha usheloshim dinar. min hecharuvin shelosha kabbin. min haegozim asara. min haafarsekin chamishsha. min harimmonim shenayim. etrog echad. veim natan lo mishshear happerot lo yifchot mikkede sheyyimkerem veyikkach bidmehen mezon shete seuddot: 
Haya lo davar muat vehaaniyyim merubbin veen bo kede litten lechol echad veechad kashshiur noten lifnehem vehen mechallekin benehem: 
Umaasar ani hammitchallek baggoren en bo tovat hanaa labbealim ella haaniyyim baim venotlin al karcho vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael motziin oto miyyado. aval hammitchallek babbayit yesh lo tovat hanaa labbealim venotno lechol ani sheyyirtze: 
Haya lo maaser baggoren veratza litteno leani kerovo o meyuddao. yesh lehaferish mechetza litteno lo. vehachetzi mechalleko lechol ani sheyyaavor kashshiur sheamarnu: 
Bamme devarim amurim sheeno noten leani ella kede savo bassade. aval im haya hammaaser babbayit mechalleko lechol haaniyyim afillu kezayit kezayit. sheeno metzuvve litten kede savo ella bassade. shehare eno motze sham likkach shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "veachlu visharecha vesaveu": 
Bau ish veishsha labbayit. notnin laishsha techilla ufotrin otah veachar kach notnin laish. av uveno. ish ukerovo. shene achin. shene shuttafin. shehaya echad mehen ani. noten lo haacher maasar ani shello: 
Shete aniyyim shekkibbelu sade baarisut. ze mafrish maasar ani mechelko venotno lachavero. vechen chavero mafrish mechelko venoten lo: 
Hamekabbel sade liktzor asur beleket shichcha ufea umaasar ani. ematay bizman shekkibbelah mimmennu likkach chelek bechol hassade kegon shennatan lo shelishah o reviah bischaro. aval im amar lo baal hassade shelish ma sheatta kotzer bilvad hu shellecha o revia ma shettiktzor hare ze en lo kelum ad sheyyiktzor. uvishat hakkatzir hu ani. lefichach muttar beleket shichcha ufea. veasur bemaasar ani sheen mafrishin maasar ani ella achar shekkatzar vahare zacha bechelko shekkatzar: 
Hammocher et sadehu karka uferot veheeni. hare ze muttar beleket shichcha ufea umaasar ani shellah. vehallokeach asur bahen af al pi sheadayin lo natan damim. vaafillu lava haddamim ulekachah hare ze asur bemattenot aniyyim: 
Maasar ani en porin mimmennu milve. veen meshallemin mimmennu et hattagmulin. aval meshallemin mimmennu davar shel gemilut chasadim vetzarich lehodio shehu maasar ani. veen podin bo shevuyim. veen osin bo shoshvinut. veen notnin mimmennu davar litzdaka. venotnin oto lachaver ir betovat hanaa. veen motziin oto mehaaretz lechutz laaretz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 28)</small> "vehinnachta bisharecha" veneemar <small>(Devarim 26 12)</small> "veachlu visharecha vesaveu":
